properties.descriptionHtml:
Located in exclusive Point Rendezvous, Arco Iris boasts panoramic views of the Caribbean Sea that will take your breath away. Your mornings will never be the same once you experience the Sunrise over stunning Fish Bay. This striking Villa offers a chance to “get away from it all” but is just ten minutes from the amazing dining, shopping, and activities of Cruz Bay and only 14 minutes from the Northshore Beaches.  

Arco Iris features three equal-size king bedrooms with air-conditioning. Each room has en-suite bathrooms, individual balconies/patio and fabulous views of Fish Bay. You will also enjoy the private indoor/outdoor showers that allow you to gaze into the Caribbean. The fully air-conditioned large open-concept great room and kitchen takes entertaining to a new level. Four sets of sliding glass doors frame the room allowing you to admire the view from anywhere in the room. 

A wide covered balcony wraps the great room creating true indoor/outdoor living spaces. You will look forward to sharing meals on the balcony while soaking in the ambiance. A 10 x 20 saltwater swimming pool featuring a 6-foot-long swim up seating bench is the centerpiece of the tiled outdoor-patio. This spacious area is furnished with chaise loungers, a comfortable conversation seating set and an outdoor Ping Pong Table for your entertainment. For your convenience, a large closet contains beach chairs, coolers, a beach umbrella and an assortment of masks and snorkels. Easy access driveway with driveway with around and ample parking spaces awaits your arrival.

Base nightly rates vary and additional per person per night charges and other fees may apply.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Five minutes from the bustling center of Cruz Bay, you will find a secluded, landscaped retreat in Contant Farm called Argonauta. With 5 spacious bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom, you will wake up each morning to spectacular ocean views. Have your coffee on the wrap around deck, sporting a 270-degree panorama of the Caribbean Sea. Then head to St John’s famous North Shore beaches, just 15 minutes away. Finish the day playing in Argonauta’s plunge pool or having a fun cocktail at the fully equipped pool bar. As the day ends, head to the hot tub to soak and watch the glorious Argonauta sunsets. When you are ready for dinner, make use of a well-equipped full chef’s kitchen or head down to Cruz Bay. Despite Argonauta’s privacy, you are just a short drive from the town center. Argonauta has two king bedroom suites in the main house. The lower main house bedroom is large enough to accommodate an additional crib or air mattress for littler guests. Its bathroom has a full outdoor shower enclosed in a screened stone grotto. The upper main house bedroom is accessed via a spiral staircase and has its own bathroom with shower. In addition to the bedroom, it has an office nook with a mahogany desk facing the sea. Two more king bedrooms are found in the adjacent guest house, each with magnificent views, stone showers, and hammocks to soothe your soul. The fifth king bedroom with en-suite bathroom is tucked away off the pool deck and contains a LifeFitness Elliptical trainer and desk. As for dining al fresco, there is a wraparound deck on the west side of the main house. It’s a great spot for dining and viewing sunsets, or watching ships large and small glide towards St. Thomas and its glittering lights in the distance.

Base nightly rates vary and additional per person per night charges and other fees may apply.

At Astral Villa, you will enjoy traditional West Indian charm with understated elegance. You will be surrounded by nature with an incredible, ever-changing Caribbean view, tropical breezes, and magical night sounds with stars galore. 

This welcoming luxury St. John Villa located in Coral Bay comfortably sleeps 6 guests with ample privacy for all. Enjoy the comfortable teak furnishings for sunning next to the palm lined pool, or curl up and read under shady overhangs, surrounded by colorful tropical flowers. No matter where you are on property, you look up to a beautiful panoramic view.

Astral Villa is designed with privacy in mind. The 3 Pavilions are separated by lush vegetation, and there are cozy seating areas tucked away throughout the property – all with fabulous views. Enjoy lazy private mornings with coffee and tropical breezes. In the evening, enjoy magical night sounds with a galaxy of stars twinkling above. Champagne optional.

This welcoming luxury St. John Villa located in Coral Bay comfortably sleeps 6 guests with ample privacy for all. Enjoy the comfortable teak furnishings for sunning next to the palm lined pool, or curl up and read under shady overhangs, surrounded by colorful tropical flowers. No matter where you are on property, you look up to a beautiful panoramic view.

The living area is furnished with modern comfortable seating, TV, ROKU, Bluetooth soundbar, and DVD player. The dining and sitting room provides ample seating for 6 or more, opens into the great room and outdoor pool terrace. A beautifully appointed, cooks’ kitchen with updated appliances and custom mahogany cabinetry.

The main primary bedroom with custom made queen bed and opens to outdoor pool terrace, with spa for nighttime star gazing. The en-suite bathroom boasts both indoor and outdoor showers. The upstairs primary bedroom has a queen bed and ensuite bathroom. The downstairs primary has a split king bed, conveniently converting into 2 twins, if desired, and en-suite bathroom.

Soak in all the natural beauty Astral Villa has to offer on the cozy balcony with steamer chairs. There is also a bistro set to enjoy peaceful morning coffee with your view. There are loungers for sunning and a swing hammock. The wraparound deck leads to a second whirlpool spa for private star gazing and beautiful, unobstructed views of Coral Bay from all vantage points.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Banana Sweet Top! 2 BEDROOM!! Hot Tub and Tesla back up power!

Welcome to Banana Sweet in beautiful Coral Bay with its laid-back shops, restaurants and music scene. This is a spacious, open floor plan apartment for 4. We added a hot tub and we are positioned with views overlooking the Carolina Valley and Hurricane Hole. You can’t beat the location which is a short 5 minute drive to Coral Bay and 10-15 minutes to the beautiful North Shore beaches. We offer a very comfortable property at a reasonable price. The bedrooms are accessed from inside the house, so no need to go outside to get to a bedroom.

This house is on the upper level, which is also ground level, and includes a living/dining/ kitchen space as well as 2 good sized bedrooms. There is a large outdoor deck as well for dining and enjoying the view both day and night.

There is a lower level apartment with a private entrance that could also be available depending on your needs. Be prepared for a short drive up our hill some of the road is gravel and some is cement. 4WD is not required but good ground clearance can be helpful.

properties.descriptionHtml:
This villa has it all! Beija Flor means “Flower-kisser” (hummingbird) in Portuguese. Beija Flor is located in exclusive Point Rendezvous and can sleep up to 8 people. Enjoy beautiful water views and spectacular ocean breezes. Beija Flor is 75 yards on a cliff above the beautiful blue waters of Fish Bay. Watch the stunning sunrises and enjoy dinner under the stars on the 500 square foot upper and lower balconies. Relax in the luxurious saltwater pool or swim in one of the many beaches close by. Beija Flor is just an 8 to 10-minute drive from the town of Cruz Bay where you can find amazing restaurants, shopping and other activities. The beautiful North Shore beaches are a 15-minute drive from the villa. As you walk into the great room, five double mahogany doors open onto the upper deck and provide expansive views to Fish Bay where you can enjoy sea turtles swimming and bobbing to the surface. Beija Flor features four king size bedrooms with air-conditioning and en-suite bathrooms. Two king size primary suites are located on each side off the great room. There is a handicap accessible ramp or stairs that will take you to the pool and to the two lower bedrooms with king size beds, both with sliders out to the lower deck with captivating views of Fish Bay. There is a connecting hallway with doors to each bedroom. All villa water is purified by an ultraviolet (UV) 3 stage filtration system. For your convenience, trash service is provided twice a week. A solar system provides electricity if there is an island-wide outage.

Base nightly rates vary and additional per person per night charges and other fees may apply.

To view more information, photos and reviews please visit VRBO at:

Beija Flor – Spectacular Water Views & Ocean breezes, Salt Water Pool, New Solar (vrbo.com)

Blue Agave Villa is located in upper Estate Chocolate Hole, overlooking 3 Bays east to west, Great Cruz Bay, Chocolate Hole Bay & Hart/Rendezvous Bay. Amazing open and covered deck area. Situated about 2 miles from Cruz Bay, this two-level, 4 bedroom, 4 bath vacation home offers privacy and comfort.

The upper level contains the primary bedroom, kitchen, living room, full bath and deck with pool. The the lower level are the three bedrooms each with ensuite bath, which is accessed via an exterior travertine stairway and a common breezeway, and each bedroom has exterior door access to each room and laundry room. The house is very comfortable and well equipped, and each bedroom is air-conditioned. To capture the island breezes, it is completely screened, and each room contains a ceiling fan. The home also has a full-house automatic generator.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Brezza di Mare features a seamless, modern design emphasizing comfort and panoramic views. The main level hosts an open-concept great room with a gourmet kitchen, dining area, and half bath, ideal for entertaining. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame breathtaking vistas of Ram Head and the Caribbean Sea. A private staircase leads down to two air-conditioned primary suites, each with a king bed, private deck, chaise lounges, and en-suite bathrooms featuring double vanities and rock showers.

Outside, the villa truly comes alive. A spacious covered outdoor living and dining area includes a sectional sofa and table for up to 10 guests—perfect for al fresco meals. The 20′ x 10′ knife-edge infinity pool and adjacent hot tub overlook the sea, while a sun deck with loungers invites relaxation. A built-in gas grill, outdoor sink, and mini-fridge make outdoor cooking effortless. Nestled at the end of a quiet road in Fish Bay, the property offers both serenity and luxury, just minutes from St. John’s pristine beaches and national park trails. The villa is at the end of its road, providing complete serenity, but is only a 12-minute drive to Cruz Bay.

Brezza di Mare is next door to its sister property, San Costanzo. For large or multi-generational groups, renting 2 bedroom/2 bathroom San Costanzo with 2 bedroom/2.5 bathroom Brezza di Mare gives guests the flexibility of privacy and time together.

Base nightly rates vary and additional per person per night charges and other fees may apply.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Located in exclusive Pt. Rendezvous, Cara Mia shows off pristine views of Fish Bay, Bordeaux Mountain, and the Caribbean Sea. This beautiful 3 king bedroom ensuites St. John Villa offers guests a welcome change of pace from the ordinary. Cara Mia is furnished in an elegant Modern Colonial motif. Cara Mia is both grand and welcoming with soaring ceilings and cool travertine floors that compliment warm mahogany details and comfortable upholstered seating in the Great Room. Crafted by local artisans from island stone and slate, Cara Mia has a charm and warmth all its own, with a covered gallery for al fresco dining. Relax in the island breezes or enjoy your meal in air-conditioned comfort with the home’s indoor or outdoor dining areas. Three equal, air-conditioned bedrooms are placed for optimum privacy, and all are oriented to take advantage of Point Rendezvous’ constant trade winds and inspiring ocean vistas, The primary suite is complete with a king size bed, and an elegant bath with an opulent shower area. The guest bedrooms offer king beds, and both are beautifully appointed and offer tasteful, oversize bathrooms ensuite. AC in Kitchen/Great Room too. Each bedroom has exterior entry, making this a serious consideration if you have young children.

Now with SOLAR BACKUP! Elegant Caribbean comfort describes this beautifully appointed Villa on St. John, US Virgin Islands, overlooking the calming waters of Fish Bay. With 6 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms, Casa Del Palmas is designed to comfortably accommodate large families, groups of friends, and small retreat groups, up to 12 guests.

You will find privacy with individual suite style bedrooms as well as a variety of open indoor and outdoor spaces to play games, gather for conversation, dine, lounge poolside, practice yoga, or tuck in alone to read a book. Casa Del Palmas is nestled hillside in a lush and quiet neighborhood only ten minutes from Cruz Bay, providing convenient access to Cruz Bay’s shopping, water sports, groceries and restaurants. Beach towels, beach chairs, coolers, and pool toys are also available to use during your stay.

Enjoy days of hiking and snorkeling the many Virgin Islands National Park trails and reefs. Go boating or go explore some of the many plantation era ruins, or simply lie by the pool with a book and glass of wine. No matter what your choice, Casa Del Palmas is designed to relax and rejuvenate the most road weary guest.

Emily

Our three-generation family of ten had a fantastic stay at Casa del Palmas. This was our third villa rental on St. John and though all have been nice (it says something that we keep coming back!), this one is my new favorite. The house is lovely and was perfect for a multi-family vacation. Each couple and set of kids had their own comfortable, private space and the shared spaces facilitated lots of fun family time together. We cooked dinner in the spacious and well-appointed kitchen almost every night and enjoyed eating all together around the big table where there was room for all of us. The kitchen had everything we needed. We also enjoyed afternoons with the kids in the pool and the adults around the outdoor bar. We loved the relative quiet of the Fish Bay neighborhood. It's a 15-ish minute trip into Cruz Bay and a great home base for exploring all St. John has to offer. We also appreciated the beach chairs, coolers, and other gear available to guests. Would definitely come again!

Brett M.

My girlfriend and I recently visited St. John and stayed at Casa Del Palmas for a week, it was the best vacation we have ever been on. The house is situated in a cozy bay right on the edge of the national park, the views from the top and bottom deck are gorgeous. The neighborhood is quiet and very friendly, oftentimes we would take a walk during the mornings and were greeted by neighbors walking their dog or taking a stroll. The location of the house makes getting to the rest of the island very convenient, we were able to visit 5-6 different beaches while we were there with no problems! They had towels, coolers, beach bags, rafts etc. readily available for use so we didn't have to bring our own. The house itself was newly renovated, the appliances were all stainless steel, granite countertops (my girlfriend's favorite was their coffee maker), all that you would expect of a top notch island property. We were more than satisfied with our stay at Casa Del Palmas and will be back sooner than later. Don't forget to take some time and add to their house coloring book and sign your name!

properties.descriptionHtml:
Overlooking the quiet community of Coral Bay, the impressive 4 1/2 acre estate affords majestic views of St. John’s East End as well as the British Virgin Islands of Tortola, Virgin Gorda, Norman Island and several smaller cays along the Sir Francis Drake Channel.

Chateau Margot is only 1½ miles from the turnoff Centerline Road that leads straight down to the amazing Maho Bay and Francis Bay Beaches and is only three miles from the center of Coral Bay. To reach the estate, travel five miles from downtown Cruz Bay, halfway through the Virgin Islands National Park, on cool tree-canopied Centerline Road. Only a short drive after passing the Reef Bay Trail entrance, the road to the estate forks off just to the right of the Bordeaux complex. From there, a half a mile of paved curves around and down to the grand white gates of Chateau Margot.

Chateau Margot shares a name with one of the world’s best wines. Margot, a red claret wine of “truly incomparable distinction and class”,  always “well-balanced and unsurpassed by any other wine on earth” makes an appropriate namesake for this estate. Being distinctive and classy, Chateau Margot stands out and above most other St. John Properties. This villa’s classic quality and exceptional superiority are impossible to deny when noticing the warmth of carved teak and mahogany woods; the lasting beauty and strength of polished granite, coral and marble tiles; and the innovative appliances, fixtures, and electronics found all throughout its structure. The artistic blending of a rich regal decor, set within coolly casual curves and angles, adapted to the middle of a secluded tropical forest, gives this estate the well-balanced “premier grand cru” classification that it truly deserves.

Winding terraces, railed wooden decks, native stone paths, gardens and koi ponds connect Chateau Margot’s three large masonry buildings.

Completely renovated under the conception and direction of talented interior designer Adette Irish, this villa showcases original art from local artists such as Amy Tracer, Les Anderson, Elaine Estern and Janet Cook-Rutnik among others. Well known names for linens, rugs, and furnishings are artfully arranged against St. John handcrafted doors, cabinetry, and native stone walls.

The interior living space is 6,165 square ft. and the exterior decking is 2,300 square ft. for a total of 8,465 square ft. of pure Caribbean paradise.  The main level of the three-story Great House holds the living, dining and kitchen areas, as well as the infinity-edged pool and sundeck.

A center planter of Philodendron Selloum separates the living room doors on the right from the individual doors for office, laundry and powder room on the left. The office has abundant built-in desk space with two chairs, a computer with wireless satellite hookup, phone, fax, copier, scanner and set of encyclopedias for those guests who just can’t leave their work behind. The laundry room contains a washer and two dryers, iron, built-in ironing board and a working table. A small powder room is located between the other two rooms for quick and convenient access from the most used living areas of the house.

The Margot Primary Suite and the Pineapple and Parrot bedrooms are on the upper level of the Great House.

Situated beside the Great House, is the 2 level Guest House, containing both the Orchid and Bamboo Suites.

Overlooking the Great House, is the freestanding Coral Cottage, a very private bedroom/bath that also has a kitchenette.

All bedrooms contain ceiling fans, and each has its own A/C. This countryside villa is ideal for one, two or three families.  The arrangement of the three upper bedrooms in the Great House is perfect for parents with younger children.

properties.descriptionHtml:
This cottage will save you $650 because of its central location. It is within easy walking distance to the VITRAN Bus—no need to rent a vehicle!

This Caribbean cabana, also affectionately known as the Christmas Cottage, offers the intrepid traveler an unforgettable St. John experience. Nestled comfortably on the valley floor of Coral Bay village in a quiet residential neighborhood, the cabana presents rustic simplicity with irresistible Caribbean charm.

The Cabana has been a ‘honeymoon’ cottage to the owners for the last five years while they constructed the main house on the property. Cozy yet airy, the cabana makes available all the outdoor living experience of camping with the convenience of electricity, refrigeration and laundry facilities. Linens, bath towels, and beach towels are provided. Situated on the level ground makes for easy access and parking.

Local grocery store, mail service, restaurants, includes local landmarks, Skinny Legs, and Aqua Bistro. Enjoy plenty of nightly entertainment a simple 5-minute walk away. Yoga classes convene several times a week at the Agricultural Pavilion, a short walk from the house. Or if Pilates is your preference, classes are available at the same convenient location. Catch the VITRAN to world-class beaches for the day, or hike the many trails on the eastern end of St. John. Head to the bustling town of Cruz Bay via the VITRAN for a dollar. Bars and restaurants, quaint boutiques and island ferry opportunities are all conveniently located to the cabana. Enjoy World-Class Beaches, Hiking & Restaurants in Coral Bay, St. John.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Cinnamon Stones sits high on the hillside of Estate Catherineberg, a small prestigious community of luxury villas, surrounded by the Virgin Islands National Park. Overlooking Cinnamon Bay, Peter Bay, Francis Bay and Johnson’s Reef, you can see from Hans Lollick and Lovango in the west, north to Jost Van Dyke and east to Tortola. It is a big, breathtaking view. The house is on one acre of beautifully landscaped land. The steep hillside is covered with old stones and a very special thirty foot high rock outcrop. The colors of the stone were an inspiration for the interior of the house. The house was designed by St. John architect and artist, Carolyn Caldwell, and constructed in 1999 by her husband, Ken Betts. It takes advantage of all the best features of Caribbean homes: thick concrete walls, an abundance of louvered doors on all sides, ceiling fans and cool stone floors. Skill and craftsmanship are evident throughout this very special house.

At Cinnamon Stones you are surrounded by the beauty of the woods and the sea. The house is a tribute to architectural restraint and a sensitivity to Caribbean style. It is place to love and to return again and again.

The Great Room is painted a cool gray lavender, the color of the British Virgin Islands and the sea at dawn and dusk, which you see through six louvered mahogany French doors. All the mahogany doors and windows were handcrafted on St. John. The floor is imported Italian limestone. There is a vaulted kingpost ceiling over the sitting area which has two very comfy sofas, perfect for watching a movie. The custom built mahogany entertainment center has a 40” LCD TV with Expanded Digital Cable, VCR, Blue Ray DVD Player, and Echo Dot.  Also included, is a large video and DVD library, or you may prefer choosing something to read from a collection of over 100 books of contemporary fiction – many award winners and best sellers of the past ten years. A selection of board games and cards are available under the kitchen island as well as large array of table linens for a special dinner inside or out on the veranda.  Original paintings by well known St. John artists hang throughout the house. Off the Great Room is a small office with desk, MFC printer and scanner capabilities, wireless DSL and more books. A guest bath is adjacent.

The interior dining area has a large antique teak table which can easily seat eight. The table settings include dinnerware by Villeroy and Bock, stainless flatware by Gorham. There is an abundance of serving pieces, platters, bowls and trays. A wine rack is built into the adjacent counter.

The kitchen is designed for serious cooking with all appliances including a gas stove, refrigerator/freezer with water and ice dispenser, and dishwasher. The white custom made cupboards with red hand glazed tile counter tops are filled with all the important and not so important kitchen equipment from Williams-Sonoma. Off the kitchen is a pantry for storage of large pots, pans, and picnic equipment.

Every door in the Great Room opens to the gracious verandah and the glorious blue sea and each door opening has retractable phantom screens.  The comfortable teak furniture on the verandah includes rockers, big arm chairs, a love seat and a dining table for enjoying the indescribable view.

You can sit at the end of the long verandah, in the swinging rope chair facing the rock shelter, the faint remains of stone terraced farming, the tyre palm grove, the bay rum tree and beautiful Cinnamon Beach below.

From the kitchen door it is a short walk to the Primary Suite across the pergola covered terrace with its fragrant night blooming jasmine. The pale grey walls, white woodwork and mahogany floors and doors create a beautiful space for the St. Croix four poster mahogany bed. The screened porch has a rocker and an armchair. The en-suite bathroom has a large, screened outdoor shower with a magnificent ocean view. There is a large walk-in closet for all your island attire and a 32” LCD Flat TV with expanded digital cable, Blue Ray DVD player, and Echo Dot for your viewing pleasure.

From the upper-level deck you look down on the 40' X 8' heated lap pool and hot tub. On the lower deck there are two roomy umbrellas that can be moved to shelter you from the sun as you lounge on the steps in the water.

All the decks are made of Trex, which has no splinters and is soft on bare feet. It is roomy around the pool with six lounge chairs along with additional tables and chairs. There is a laundry room off the pool deck with a washer, dryer, ice maker, ice bucket, drinkware and small refrigerator for cold drinks. There is also an adjacent full bathroom which opens onto the deck. On the lower level are two large bedrooms each with a unique bathroom and walk-in closet. The Rock Suite has a king size bed which is a copy of a plantation bed and large en-suite bath. On the mahogany table is a 32″ LCD TV with expanded digital cable, Blue Ray DVD player, and Echo Dot.  The pale blue walls glow as light filters through the mahogany louvered doors. All doors have full sliding screens so that the louvered doors may be left open, if desired.  Adjacent to the Rock Suite is the Kids Suite, with two sets of bunk beds, en-suite bath and a pass through door to the Rock Suite, a perfect set up for small children.

The beautiful lower verandah has more comfortable rockers and arm chairs with a hammock for afternoon naps.  A circular second stairway leads to the Great Room from the end of the verandah.

The Pool Suite has a king size four poster mahogany bed and en-suite bath. The room is painted soft green to reflect the tropical woods which surround the house. There is a big comfortable wicker chair with footstool perfect for watching a movie on the 32” LCD TV with expanded digital cable, DVD Player and Echo Dot, all located in the large red Chinese armoire. The bathroom is wonderful, with a large shower with mahogany louvered doors which open to the hillside garden.

Located in St. John, US Virgin Islands, and set high above Coral Bay, the Coral Sky Villa offers stunning views of Coral Bay, the British Virgin Islands, and the Bordeaux Valley. Coral Sky Villa sits on a half-acre lot and features 4 bedrooms and 3.5 baths with a floor plan designed for incredible indoor/outdoor living spaces and with privacy in mind. Coral Sky Villa is located on the prestigious Majestic Mile in the exclusive community of Upper Carolina in Coral Bay and sits 650 feet above sea level which embraces the soothing Tradewinds and spectacular views. Upper Carolina also features fully paved roads. Coral Sky Villa was newly built from the ground up in 2017. Life can be slowly savored at Coral Sky Villa, morning coffee on the decks, a rum and tonic by the pool in the tropical sun, a canopy of a million stars at night. We offer large outdoor covered patios and open sun decks with amazing views of Coral Bay and the British Virgin Islands. A gated entry leads to a beautifully landscaped villa that sits perfectly across the lot. Drive up Seagrape Hill to Desert Rose which offers an excellent parking platform for 2 cars. Steps lead down to an open Caribbean style private home. Desert Rose Villa is beautiful and spacious for easy living in Paradise. A great place to relax, swim and soak in the warm sunshine and watch Coral Bay go by. Take a dip in your private pool to cool down after a day at the Beach. Enjoy the large sundeck and a convenient outdoor bathroom. Sunshine all day and a covered veranda gets you out of the sun and cool off with the ceiling fans. Beautiful views of Coral Bay, Moravian Church and Bordeaux Mountain. The Great Room with its vaulted ceiling and ceiling fans is perfect to read, listen to music, watch T.V. or do nothing at all. properties.descriptionHtml:
Drake’s View is a luxury villa that has the same vista named by the Caribbean Travel magazine as “the best view in the Caribbean” – a spectacular view of the British Virgin Islands and the East Shore of St. John. One to four couples or a large family will have ample room for privacy, and relaxation.

Drake’s View is a four bedroom, 4.5 bath villa with a tile patio, heated swimming pool, and hot tub. Four additional tile decks, a large tiled front porch, and a separate cottage terrace provide ample outdoor lounging areas. One of the bedrooms is in a separate cottage.

Drake’s View is centrally located on Bordeaux Mt., the highest point in St. John (almost 1300 feet), and is surrounded by lush vegetation. The roads leading to there are all paved and the villa is surrounded by lush local vegetation. It is a 6-minute drive to the VI National Park North Shore beaches; 3-minutes to the Reef Bay Trail; 7-minutes to Coral Bay; 15-minutes the Cruz Bay; and is one-quarter mile from Château Bordeaux, one of the island’s great restaurants. From the front door, you can hike the Bordeaux Mountain Trail to secluded Lameshur Beach in one hour. The well-equipped kitchen is very spacious and includes one of two dining areas. Three bedrooms have king sized beds and one has a king, convertible to twins. Each bedroom has air-conditioning, a private bath, and Swedish TempurPedic mattresses. All the bathrooms are the same with tiled showers and plenty of cabinet space. Two Tesla Powerwalls have been installed to make the villa more environmentally friendly, and help guests avoid any power outages during their stay.

The traditional architecture of the house entrance with yellow stucco, red roof, and simple columns contrasts with a dramatic facade of glass along the east wall. No matter where you look in the house or cottage, you see Coral Bay, the valley of Estate Carolina, Drake’s Passage, and the British Virgin Islands. On a clear day, you can see the Baths at Virgin Gorda. Rainbows, mangrove cuckoos, kestrels and red-tailed hawks are common sights.

Drake’s View has the ambiance of a home rather than a rental. The large great room is furnished with Indonesian, American antiques, and contemporary, comfortable, plantation style furniture. Local art is featured throughout the house.

This property features a cottage with separate bedroom, for added privacy.

East End Seascape on St. John, offering a three bedroom vacation rental accommodation with a swimming pool that has a beautiful sunrise ocean view. Each bedroom has air-conditioning and the rest of the villa is kept cool by the historic tradewinds. Perfect for your holiday or honeymoon.

Here is St John at it’s best. A private luxurious outpost perched on a cliff on the island’s tranquil East End with a breathtaking sea view in every direction. Leave stress behind on a scenic 15 minute drive from Coral Bay. The road is dotted with sparkling little beaches and panoramic vistas.

Feast your eyes and restore your soul. This three bedroom vacation rental is a perfect place for a honeymoon or anniversary retreat. Designed to accommodate up to 6 guests, it’s also fun for a family or small group of friends.

East End Seascape is like being at anchor on a private luxury yacht. Feel yourself surrounded by softly crashing surf, rocky outcrops that lead into clear swirling waters, a tranquil bay and endless sea dotted with islands stretching into the horizon.

Relax in the shade of the arch-framed deck and watch sailboats drift by below. Watch birds soar past – almost close enough to touch. Have dinner al fresco as the setting sun plays on the bay. The evening is magical. See a cruise ship glide past. Take an evening swim with the pool illuminated from within then sit on the poolside veranda under a sky chock full of stars. properties.descriptionHtml:
Fish Tales is a cute and comfortable two bedroom, 2 1/2 bath Caribbean Cottage with nice views of Fish Bay and the surrounding area out to Bovocap Point and Little St. James Island.

A short walk from the home brings you to the National Park and Reef Bay. Walk down a short trail from Fish Tales and you are on the beach, where, in calm weather, the snorkeling is great. On windier days you can watch the surfers, or hike along the beach, over the low rocks, walk along a second beach, over a trail to a third beach where the Reef Bay Sugar Mill ruins are located. You can then go up the famed Reef Bay trail to the petroglyphs.

This spacious home away from home is easily accessed via a large flat driveway. Two small steps up from Fish Tales driveway and you enter the home from a covered deck. The door leads you into the Great Room with comfortable seating, TV, DVD player, and Stereo. Cable TV and wireless internet are provided. The kitchen and dining area, as well as a half bath with full-size laundry all, flow easily off the great room. A sliding door opens up to the large covered and uncovered pool deck. At the far end of the great room is the entrance to the primary bedroom, as well as, the internal stairway to the lower bedroom.


The large primary bedroom has great views and a king size bed with a very comfortable memory foam mattress. A sliding door takes you out to the covered deck. There is a full, private, en-suite bath in the primary bedroom. The lower bedroom has a queen sized bed and a twin sized day bed with trundle that can expand the daybed into two twin beds or one king-sized bed. All mattresses are very comfortable memory foam. A private full en-suite bath, closet, and small beverage refrigerator. There is a sliding door to a private deck with views of Fish Bay.


Outside on the main level at Fish Tales is a large covered and uncovered pool deck. The dipping pool is 8 x 13 x 3, and it is surrounded by 4 chaise lounge chairs. The outside dining table with seating for six and a Weber grill provides an easy, comfortable outdoor living space. Fish Tales is quiet, comfortable, and only 15 minutes from downtown Cruz Bay. Enjoy!

properties.descriptionHtml:
Great Escape is located a world away in Estate Catherineburg, nestled in the national park above Cinnamon Bay. This 4 Bed/4 Bath, luxury home offers an escape from reality, but boasts the technology and creature comforts you’d expect in a 5-star resort.

Rich, contemporary Caribbean ambiance will draw you in from the moment you enter this house. Handcrafted mahogany furnishings accent this home, as stunning as it is livable. A media room is off of the main living area, for viewing the latest DVD’s or videos, or listening to your favorite island rhythms on the sound system. In addition, TVs are located in every bedroom and even the wet bar, so you never have to miss a favorite episode or major game while you are visiting paradise. The gourmet kitchen is truly a chef's delight, with state of the art appliances, custom mahogany cabinetry and sleek granite countertops.


The pool deck offers entertainment of a different kind, with a 60′ x 12′ swimming pool pool for lounging or laps. The pool features a changing light display along with color water-spouts, a very unique feature. A large hot tub equipped with its own sound system and a large relaxing hammock. On either side of the pool are gazebos, each furnished with a table and four chairs for soaking up that incredible view!

All of this, in a setting unmatched anywhere, with views to mesmerize from sunup to sundown. Enjoy all the creature comforts and the unforgettable sights and sound of the natural wonder which is St. John, here at Great Escape. This stunning property features 4 fully air-conditioned bedrooms, 2 kings and 2 queens, all designed to take advantage of the breathtaking vistas at every opportunity.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Enter a place of calm, peace and tranquility, named for the mythical bird who nested on the sea and calmed the waves. Enjoy the soothing breezes of the trade winds that blow through the house most of the time.


Halcyon Days is for those who love hiking and going to the beach, but it also makes you glad to be back to your home away from home. Relax in the spacious family room that accommodates up to ten people.

Prepare a meal in the main kitchen or on the barbecue deck and dine at a teak table that seats twelve. Lounge outside soaking in the lush surroundings in your choice of the multiple deck options. Ours is a house meant for lots of cooking, loving, and living.


Halcyon Days has four spacious bedrooms, two with their own private bathrooms. Our primary bedroom has its own intimate galley kitchen, and an open air covered porch with a view of Johnson Bay, Hurricane Hole, and Coral Bay framed by amazing Mongoose Junction style Danish stone columns. Enjoy your breakfast while watching the sailboats move in and out of Coral Bay harbor.

The other two bedrooms share a large full bathroom looking out on St. John’s East End and Tortola. All four bedrooms have their own individual air-conditioning units, should your room warm up in the afternoon.

Relax in the atrium looking out the front door to Norman Island and a national park protected fringing reef, in the shade of a Schefflera tree. Or sunbathe on the large main deck upstairs, while listening to the sound of waves breaking. Play your favorite games or enjoy happy hour in the large bricked courtyard by a refreshing fountain. Use our dumb waiter to move snacks and drinks from the main kitchen to the courtyard without having to go up and down the stairs.

You will have access to three refrigerators, a washer/dryer, two kitchens, a large stove, two convection ovens, the dumb waiter, and a large propane Weber grill. Everything you need to fix your gourmet meal is available. And if the power goes out, as it frequently does on St. John, there is a large generator that will kick on automatically and make sure you are not interrupted, whether you are cooking, playing, or working.

We are happy to share Halcyon Days with you and want you to enjoy its many pleasures and gifts as much as we do.

Rules of the House
(A) Enjoy yourself! Get on island time.
(B) Come again soon.
(C) Let us know anything you need.

properties.descriptionHtml:
The Hart Bay Beach House located directly on Hart Bay Beach and below the Hart Bay Great House was designed and built with quality lifestyle and love of beauty in mind. Wake up to the sounds of the surf from this beachside haven.

Located directly on Hart Bay Beach this home offers dramatic views of the ocean, south side of St. John, Hart Bay, Rendezvous Bay and south all the way to the white cliffs of Reef Bay and south to St. Croix. The paved driveway has space for two vehicles and a turn around. The house is surrounded by the lush tropical gardens, a private setting and one with nature.

The villa includes 3 bedrooms 3 baths, an expansive great room, ideal for entertaining, dining and casual living. The large living space includes a sofa with two chairs, floor lamps, coffee table, complete entertainment center including wall mounted 50″ TV, with cable and streaming services, DVD player, and Blue Tooth Speaker. Wireless DLS complete this electronics package. This peaceful setting puts you at one with nature.

All furnishings are the best of quality for comfort and relaxation. The great room includes a fully equipped gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances and a side by side refrigerator/freezer with filtered water and ice dispensers. This area is a lovely focal point for family meals as it opens onto the spacious bar counter, with seating for four, and to the unique sculptured wood dining table with comfortable cushioned seating for six as well as 2 side chairs. The Hart Bay Beach House has 2200 square feet of spacious living.

The outside deck has open and covered areas for lounging or enjoying breakfast, lunch or dinner from the outside dining table with seating for six. Allow St. John to seduce you with her natural beauty and the Hart Bay Beach House to enrapture you with its magnificent seaside location and comfortable living areas.

Enjoy the spectacular ocean views from the expansive deck or take a stroll to the beach. From the lower primary balcony, you exit the gate and follow the pavers to the delightful sand and stone beach of Hart Bay, where you can swim, snorkeling and beachcomb. Beachfront homes on St. John are a rare and special treat and this beach is very private. The constant sounds of the ocean will make it hard to leave this amazing location!!

The spacious Primary Suite opens onto a shaded deck, where you will find 2 relaxing chaise lounges. Gaze out to the surf and the verdant green hills of St. John from your luxurious king bed or private deck.

Located on the opposite end of the great room you will find the Guest Bedroom which has 2 twin beds, a dresser, table lamp, and large closet. This set up is perfect for families with children or for singles.

Exiting the the large sliding glass doors from the Great Room, to the left you will find stairs to the second Primary Suite. This suite has outside access only.

A beautiful king bed with foot board bench, matching nightstands, lamps and a dresser as well as a walk in closet. A wall mounted 32″ TV with expanded cable is also included.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Hart Bay Great House is located on the southwest end of Hart Bay. This four bedroom three and a half bath beachfront villa is a perfect villa for newlyweds, families, and small groups. Convenient to the main town of Cruz Bay, where you will find shopping, dining and the road to the famous North Shore beaches of the National Parks. Hart Bay Great House is located on Hart Bay beach.

The 45 ft. X 14 ft. pool is 52 in. deep with bench seating throughout and 3500 sq. ft. of decking. The upper and lower outside decks feature glass top dining tables with seating for six. As an added safety feature, a gate has been added at the top of the stairs.

The beautiful gourmet kitchen features Corian countertops, mahogany cabinets, and ocean-view cooking. Included are a refrigerator, gas top range and oven, dishwasher, microwave, and additional gourmet amenities. Ideal for the gourmet chef.

The formal mahogany dining table with seating for eight and a large mahogany buffet complete this pleasurable dining experience.

The Great Room features a comfortable Seagrass loveseat with two large chairs and glass top coffee table. Two plantation style sitting chairs with mahogany accents table to give you plenty of seating for watching tv or the fabulous ocean views of the south to St. Croix and east to Ram’s head and the vast Caribbean Sea.

The large mahogany armoire contains all the electronics for your viewing and listening pleasure: A 27″ Sony, flat panel TV with expanded digital cable, VCR, stereo, CD player and Bose Sound Dock. The upper and lower outside decks feature glass top dining tables with seating for six. As an added safety feature, a gate has been added at the top of the stairs.

The Sunrise Suite

This lovely suite is named for the spectacular sunrises you see each morning from the mahogany, king size, four poster canopy bed. His and hers mahogany nightstands with matching lamps are included, along with a telephone, ceiling fan and air-conditioning. A mahogany & rattan four drawer dresser with a large closet to house all your Caribbean attire. A sitting chair is available for watching TV on the 19″ Sylvania, flat screen TV with expanded digital cable service.

Sliding glass doors open to the outside deck where two relaxing chaise lounges await you. For soaking up the sun, watching the stars or enjoying the fabulous down island views. A private bath with spacious shower including a coral stone accent wall and view to the sea completes this fabulous suite.

The Hibiscus Suite
The Hibiscus Suite contains a stately mahogany king bed with matching nightstands. Each nightstand has a lamp for reading, telephone, and ceiling fan. This suite is air-conditioned with a full bath just outside containing a large shower and full-size sink/vanity. A large 4 drawer rattan dresser is included for all your island attire along with a large closet. Sliding glass door takes you out to the large deck with chairs or chaise lounges for relaxing by day or night.

The expansive lower level includes table seating for eight, a gas grill, as well as eight reclining lounge chairs all with comfortable cushions. The expansive deck gives you plenty of room to spread out. Whether you prefer the sun or shade let the sounds of the surf lull you to sleep.

The Coconut Cabana
The Coconut Cabana has two twin beds that can easily be converted to a king. Cottage Style white wicker headboards with matching nightstands and lighting. A circular mirror adorns the 5 drawer wicker/rattan dresser along with a large walk-in closet. Three sliding windows allow for cooling tradewinds, or air-conditioning is also available. Two bedroom doors give easy access to the sitting room area just outside. Directly across is the private half bath and shared shower.

The Seaside Suite
The Seaside Suite, located on the lower level is appointed with cottage style white wicker king sized bed including matching nightstands and table lamps. A large 6 drawer wicker dresser and closet are included for all of your vacation wardrobe. A sliding glass door opens to the expansive pool deck where a large rope style hammock and pillow are ready to relax in.

A private half bath with adjacent shared shower are included along with air-conditioning, and large Adirondack chair for reading, listen to the sounds of the sea or gazing out at to the spectacular ocean view.

You’ll enjoy the villa’s convenient location, 10 minutes from the town of Cruz Bay and 15 minutes from National Park beaches. Just a short walk below lies Hart Bay Beach where you can swim, snorkel or beach comb to your Heart’s Delight.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Idyllic is a completely air-conditioned, 3 bedroom home with a private pool and cabana nestled on the ridge overlooking Great Cruz Bay, just a few minutes from town and the ferry dock.

And, then there is the large pool and deck surrounded by flowering shrubs with a captivating view. The comfortable deck furniture, and cabana, outdoor shower, half bath and gas grill provides for easy living pool-side. Enjoy the large private pool (30’ x 11’ x 4’) with outdoor rinse shower.

The indoor living area is furnished in cool, island colors, with wrapped sea grass furniture and artwork complimenting the natural beauty of St. John. The 4 panel slider opens fully onto the upper deck and is also screened. There is a complete entertainment unit with color TV, cable, VCR/DVD and combination radio, tape/CD music system. The kitchen is a delight with all the latest appliances, gourmet pots and cooking gadgets, huge granite counter, and a breakfast bar.

Idyllic was designed to take advantage of the Caribbean breezes and incredible views of Great Cruz Bay. The covered deck across the front of the house provides protected outdoor living space with seating and dining areas. The beautiful teak dining table set seats 6 in comfort.

After relaxing in the pool, you’re sitting on the deck looking at the view, a harbor replete with boats, Pillsbury Sound, the hills of St. Thomas in the distance.

The house is fully equipped with gear for the beach – coolers, towels, and beach chairs.

Idyllic is landscaped with tropical plants such as flamboyant, bougainvillea, oleander, hibiscus, and palm trees and you can help yourself to fruits in season – bananas, tamarinds, limes, passion fruit, and more. There are sunsets year round and at night the twinkling lights and stars.

properties.descriptionHtml:
A Relaxing Couples Getaway

In Harmony Retreat is a luxurious, one-bedroom villa on Seagrape Hill in Coral Bay, St. John. Perfect for honeymooners. From this stunning hilltop, you can see from the town of Coral Bay, with its beckoning restaurants and bars, to the shores and mountains of the British Virgin Islands across the sea. Sit on one of your private balconies, bask in the dipping pool-spa, or relax in your air-conditioned villa. The choice is yours.

In Harmony is just minutes from the famous pristine beaches of the National Park. Hike the park’s trails or dive into the warm waters. There is plenty to do only a phone call away, such as hiking, kayaking, diving, snorkeling, swimming, and fishing. Not only is there plenty to do, there is also plenty not to do. In Harmony Retreat is so comfortable you may not want to leave. Inside In Harmony, you will find custom-built cypress-wood walls, cable television, and high-speed Internet access.

Enjoy the Caribbean-style four-poster bed. Make yourself at home in the state-of-the-art kitchen, replete with hand-crafted cabinetry and stainless steel appliances. Have a private chef or masseuse come up to spoil you.

Outside you can grill on the barbecue, or lounge in the dipping pool-spa. Look down on half a dozen islands or read a book under a palm tree. Pick your new favorite tropical flower from the unique island landscaping. Watch the sun set in breathtaking shades of pink and yellow or the moon rise over the Caribbean at midnight. Count the shooting stars and the wishes you make on them.

Be in harmony with nature. Be in harmony with yourself. Be in harmony with life.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Island Breeze in the heart of charming Coral Bay. Nestled at the end of a private paved road, you will appreciate the easy access off Centerline Road. No challenging navigation up and down an unpaved mountain road.

Enjoy all the comforts of home with 2 or 3 air-conditioned bedrooms with private baths.  No open loft bedrooms or living room sofa beds. Large hot tub, well equipped kitchen, WIFI, entertainment center in our lovingly well-appointed private home. New solar battery backup power. No hidden extra administration and cleaning fees.

Take in our unique panoramic view of Coral Bay Harbor looking straight out to the horizon. Relax watching sail boats and hummingbirds come and go. See the popular Lime Out taco boat and wandering goats and donkeys from our decks. 

GREAT VALUE – FLEXIBILE RENTAL OPTIONS:
  • Rent the main house with two bedrooms with private baths: one with a garden shower has a king or two twin beds. The other has a queen and private bath with a glass block shower. Perfect for two couples or a family with two children.
  • Third bedroom and bath on the lower deck adds more privacy and flexibility with king or two twin beds. Perfect for grandparents, a couple looking for more privacy or a children’s retreat with TV entertainment.
  • Compare other villa features, rates and extra hidden fees to see how Island Breeze is a great value for you to enjoy!

CONVENIENCE:
Island Breeze’s central, easy access location makes it convenient to North Shore, South Shore, East End beaches and National Park hiking adventures. Only 10 minutes to Maho Bay Beach and 25 minutes to Cruz Bay restaurants and shops. You will be just a few minutes to Famous Skinny Legs, other fun restaurants, eclectic shops and three grocery stores in the heart of Coral Bay. 

While staying at Island Breeze be sure to check-out our guest book. It’s filled with suggestions and reviews of beaches, hiking, water sports, restaurants from our many repeat guests.

properties.descriptionHtml:
At the same time, the location offers easy access to Cruz Bay via the ‘dollar bus’. Car rentals are optional. Separate and autonomous, living is simple and independent. The tidy and serene studio is arranged for comfort. The arched door frames your view of the surrounding lush tropical mountain landscape.

Enjoy basking in the splendor of the outdoors on the spacious wrap-around deck perched on the upper level to catch the constant island breezes. Island Gardens driveway is on level ground and makes for trouble-free access and parking.

Local landmarks including Skinny Legs, and Jolly Dog, are all within easy walking distance. Enjoy plenty of nightly entertainment. You’ll pass the local grocery store and several gift shops along the way—all a simple 5-minute walk. Yoga classes convene several times a week at the Calabash Boom Housing (hitch a ride with the owner/ Marcia). Or if Pilates is your preference, classes are available at the Agricultural Pavilion. The VITRAN passes hourly. Two-thirds of St. John is a U.S. national park with historic ruins, protected beaches, and hiking trails.

Boating, snorkeling, fishing, windsurfing, paddle boarding, surfing, and scuba diving are just some of the adventures that await you. Catch the island shuttle bus, to world-class beaches for the day. Hike the many trails on the eastern end of St. John, or head to the bustling town of Cruz Bay–for a dollar. Bars and restaurants, quaint boutiques and island ferry excursions are all conveniently located to the studio.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Intimate getaway or affordable family gathering, the first floor of our newly completed island home is perfect for your carefree tropical vacation. The tidy and serene studio is arranged as a separate and independent living space and can accommodate two couples or a family of four. The airy, comfortable studio invites sights and sounds of a tropical paradise. Three sets of French doors frame your view of the surrounding lush and seductive mountain landscape. Enjoy basking in the splendor of the outdoors on the spacious wrap-around deck. Our grotto-inspired bathroom evokes the island’s history of stonework and exemplifies our love affair with outdoor living. Sun-drenched yet private, the enclosed shower offers a luxurious bathing experience.

Situated on the level ground makes for trouble-free access and parking. The local grocery store, mail service, and restaurants, including local landmark Skinny Legs, are all within easy walking distance.

Enjoy plenty of nightly entertainment–a simple 5-minute walk. Yoga classes convene several times a week at the Agricultural Pavilion, a short walk from the house. Or if Pilates is your preference, classes are available at the same convenient location. Catch the VITRAN, the island shuttle bus, to world-class beaches for the day, hike the many trails on the eastern end of St. John, or head to the bustling town of Cruz Bay–for a dollar. Bars and restaurants, quaint boutiques and island are all conveniently located to the studio.

The eco kitchen includes a single/double burner propane camp-stove, countertop convection oven, microwave, a full-size refrigerator with freezer on top (on deck) as well as a convenient bar refrigerator (inside) and sinks with running hot/cold water. Cooking Utensils Provided. Enjoy Coral Bay, St John in the US Virgin Islands.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Private setting. Beautiful home, serene view, pool, and tropical landscaping Miles Away is an elegant two-bedroom villa located in Point Rendezvous, only a few minutes from the shopping and restaurants of Cruz Bay. Tucked into a serene and private setting at the end of a road, this villa is perfect for honeymooners looking for privacy, two couples, or a small family. Two equally sized bedrooms are located on opposite ends of a large and airy great room, and each features a custom made, King sized teak bed and ensuite bath. When it is time for dinner – or just a cool drink – the fully appointed kitchen is a cook’s dream. Just outside is a lovely private pool, and the decks provide relaxing spots for sun lovers and shade seekers alike, with the peace and serenity of Ram’s Head in the distance, Fish Bay down in front, St. Croix off to the right, and the National Park mountains to the left. While the easterly sea breezes keep the home comfortable, there is air conditioning throughout, with individual controls in each room. Solar panels and a battery backup system keep the electricity flowing if the power goes out. All rooms, decks and the pool are on the same level, so there are no steps to climb. If exercise is on your list of things to do, walk down to Fish Bay, to Klein Bay or Ditleff Point. The pool will be there to cool you off upon your return! When you are ready to explore St. John the National Park beaches and snorkeling are just a short drive from Miles Away.

This Villa has a spectacular view of the British Virgin Islands, Coral Bay and the islands east-end. Notre Ciel’s breathtaking view is conveniently located only minutes from shopping and restaurants in lovely Cruz Bay or a short drive to eclectic Coral Bay. Hiking in the National Park and the beaches on the incredible north coast are also only minutes away. Now with A/C in 2 bedrooms!

The living room has a cathedral ceiling giving it an openness which is eclipsed only by the panoramic view. Relax here with WIFI enabled TV and smart speaker, or lay back and enjoy the beauty of the Virgin Islands from the best seat on the island.

Our guests spend time on our veranda enjoying the spectacular view of the neighboring British Virgin Islands and the east end of St. John. Enjoy coffee with the morning sun, drinks at twilight and dinner with the stars.

Bring your sun shade – beach umbrellas are getting ready to be banned – to save the turtle nests in the National Park.

This beautifully appointed villa has two bedrooms, one Queen and one King both with A/C . Each bedroom has its own bathroom. A spiral staircase leads to additional sleeping quarters in a loft furnished with a double and a single bed (no A/C).

properties.descriptionHtml:
Oceana Villa, located in Chocolate Hole, is a classic Caribbean style 6 Bedroom, 6 1/2 bath home featuring pool, split system A/C in every room, including the great room up and media room down.

This easy access home has great views overlooking Great Cruz Bay. Luxuriating in the infinity edge pool you'll enjoy seeing St. Thomas, framed by the outer cays on the horizon. Oceana’s pool is a healthy 10’ x 18’, with a maximum depth of 5 feet.

The great room has cable TV, DVD, and stereo. Sound feeds into the spa area, kitchen and decks off the great room and pool, each with individual volume controls. While Oceana is surrounded with all the Caribbean delights St. John has to offer, it was purposely designed as a villa to be stayed in.

The great room and kitchen are fully screened and has spilt A/C option, in case our normally generous trade winds are light, and will make for some truly memorable gatherings. With gourmet level appliances, meals can be prepared or catered to any level of sophistication. A four-stage filter provides crystal clear drinking water from every faucet.

With 6 air-conditioned bedrooms on two levels, Oceana accommodates nearly any size group. The villa is child-friendly and ideal for multiple generation families, with a handicap accessible bath. The upper level has three rooms with king beds, each with separate access. All bedrooms have ocean views.

Arthur

Have been traveling to St John for more than 28 years and Oceana is by far the nicest villa we have ever stayed in. Spacious, private, close to town, easy access, and very comfortable. All the bedrooms are separated in a way to offer privacy to each guest, very well furnished with plush bedding and a/c in every room. Fantastic views and sunsets. Nice dipping pool to cool off in after a day in the sun. I would absolutely rent from Vacation Vistas again, and would not hesitate to request Oceana as my first choice. Five stars!

Sue

We enjoyed a wonderful week with friends at Oceana in January. The house perfectly designed and thoughtfully and thoroughly furnished, sited overlooking Great Cruz Bay and St Thomas beyond. Every detail was considered to provide the perfect island vacation. The house accommodated 9 of us providing both privacy with individual decks and a shared terrace for gathering and dining. And St Johns perfect beaches are moments away, though many of us were perfectly happy on the terrace. We hope to return often and when we do, we will look forward to returning to the Oceana. Thanks to our hosts for creating this retreat. The pictures don’t do it justice.

Oceanport is a secluded villa located just 5 minutes from Cruz Bay on St. John, U.S Virgin Islands, offering stunning 180 degree ocean views of Hart Bay and beyond. Guests enjoy uninterrupted vistas from every room and deck, with frequent sightings of marine life and breathtaking sunsets. Children over 8 years allowed.

Oceanport features a heated 25 ft x 15 ft pool with an integrated spa, positioned to receive sunlight all day (9am to 5pm), ideal for lounging and dining on the spacious coral stone patio. Outdoor dining accommodations for 8, a gas grill, and bar enhance al fresco living.

Guests can descend the 220 private stone steps to a quiet beach for snorkeling, swimming, sunbathing, beachcombing, or exploring the shore. This is a scenic trek along a rocky shoreline.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Orchid Garden is your romantic getaway on St. John. A Greek Morrocan style villa overlooking the aqua blue Caribbean sea. Relax, enjoy, unwind, and be inspired at Orchid Garden. Located within 20 minutes walking distance to a white sandy beach and bird sanctuary.

A tropical 0asis of nature. Exotic orchids, coy fish ponds, and many beautiful indigenous plants surround you. A private world of exotic treasures from the Far East of Ric and Lolita (owners of Now @ Zen stores on St. John).

Million dollar views of the BVI’s, East end, St. Croix and endless 245-degree views of sea, sky, islands, sunrise, moonrise and spectacular clouds and rainbows. Frigates, pelicans, and Seahawks glide by and watch the bay below for the humpback whales which migrate through every winter.

Ric and Lolita have been traveling throughout Asia for over 24 years and have built their home around their art. Once you experience the beauty and tranquility of Orchid Garden you will come back for more. Private masseuse and caterer can be arranged ahead of time.

Even though we are a 2 bedroom we prefer to rent to one couple only to keep the feeling of a romantic getaway with peaceful surroundings. We were called Buddha Garden but changed the name to Orchid Garden because we are passionate about collecting orchids.

The owners are available in the apartment down below if any problems arise. You have your own private entrance and total privacy. Spectacular cloud watching, sunset afterglow from flat Mediterranean roof shade pagoda. Bring your body leave your stress behind. Love, peace, happiness

properties.descriptionHtml:
Escape to a tropical oasis at Palladio’s View, a stunning villa perched on the East End of St. John. Overlooking Coral Bay, this enchanting 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath retreat is the ultimate getaway, offering three luxurious king-sized beds, a private hot tub, and a sparkling pool.

With breathtaking views of the turquoise waters below, every corner of this home invites you to unwind and embrace paradise. This home is also equipped with an HVAC system, which adds an extra bit of comfort in this tropic environment! Guest’s will enjoy A/C in each bedroom, as well as the living area and kitchen.

It’s very common for the island to have power outages! Palladio’s View is equipped with backup Tesla Powerwall battery storage and solar panels to maintain all systems (except hot tub and A/C) while the local power grid is down.

Step into the spacious living area, where comfort and style meet. Plush seating and thoughtfully selected decor create an inviting atmosphere, while walls of windows bathe the room in natural light and offer uninterrupted views of Coral Bay and the British Virgin Islands.

This open, airy space seamlessly flows into the fully equipped kitchen, designed to make island living a breeze. The kitchen boasts full-sized appliances, including a refrigerator, gas stove, oven, microwave, and ample cabinet and counter space—perfect for preparing everything from casual snacks to gourmet meals. A dishwasher, coffee maker, and toaster are also provided for your convenience.

Just off the kitchen is a cozy dining area with seating for four, but we highly encourage you to dine al fresco on the expansive deck, where the tropical breezes and stunning scenery will elevate every meal.

Outside, the villa is an entertainer’s dream. The multi-level deck is designed for ultimate outdoor enjoyment, with various seating areas, including plush sofas, love seats, and dining tables. Relax in the sun loungers, take a dip in the pool, or indulge in a peaceful soak in the hot tub—this is your private paradise, where every moment is an opportunity to relax and recharge.

Pack light! We provide our guests with bath towels, washcloths, toiletries, bedding, and everything you will need to enjoy your stay. Guests will also have access to a smart TV, where they can sign into their own streaming services to enjoy (just be sure to sign out after your departure!). High-speed WiFi is also available for our guests.

The first king suite is a sanctuary of relaxation, with private access to the deck and a wealth of natural light streaming in through expansive windows. A dresser and closet provide ample storage space for your belongings, ensuring you feel right at home. The en-suite bathroom is a true highlight, featuring elegant stone countertops, plenty of storage, and a shower like no other—partially open to the outdoors, offering a unique and refreshing experience in nature’s embrace. A/C is included in this room!

The second bedroom also features a king-sized bed and is located on the other side of the house from the first bedroom. From this room, you’ll wake up to sweeping views of the Virgin Islands’ lush landscape and crystal-clear waters. The en-suite bathroom mirrors the other, with a stone vanity, chic sink, and a partially outdoor shower that brings the beauty of nature indoors. A wardrobe provides additional storage, ensuring you have everything you need for your stay. Guests' will have cold A/C in this room as well.

Upstairs, the second bedroom is a loft-style retreat, also with a king-sized bed and plenty of space for storage in the closet and wardrobe. A half bath is located in the loft, and guests will have access to A/C in this space as well.

At Palladio’s View, every detail is crafted for your comfort, offering the perfect balance of luxury and tranquility. We can’t wait for you to experience this tropical haven in the heart of the Virgin Islands. Palladio’s View is only 20 minutes away from some world famous beaches, including Trunk Bay, Maho Bay, and Cinnamon Bay. These are some must-see destinations during your stay with us!

properties.descriptionHtml:
Located on a spectacular point of high land that juts out over the water on St. John’s quiet East End, this spacious 3 bedroom Virgin Island villa rental overlooks Coral Bay, Haulover Bay and a beautiful reef. Proximity to the water, good snorkeling, and your own beach set this vacation villa apart from other waterfront properties on the island.

A private staircase leads down from the house to the stone beach complete with beach chairs and a hammock. Excellent snorkeling for beginners and experienced swimmers alike.  Soak in the stunning blue waters surrounding Pebble Cove. The bay offers a beautiful mix of underwater scenery, varieties of coral, and a myriad of tropical fish. Several other sand beaches, Haulover Bay and Hansen Bay, are located within a 5 to 10-minute walk from Pebble Cove.


Pebble Cove sleeps up to eight people. The living room provides stunning 220-degree views of sparkling bays and green mountains. Sliding doors allow for a gentle cross-breeze to keep the house cool. Additionally, it offers Wi-Fi, a quiet A/C, and a flat screen television with ROKU. A powder room tucked underneath the stairs offers a main room bathroom near the kitchen, dining, and living areas.

The kitchen is equipped with a propane stove and oven, dishwasher, refrigerator and freezer, beverage mini-fridge, microwave, toaster, a coffee maker with filters, filtered tap water, and complete cooking and dining utensils. A propane grill is located just outside the kitchen down a few stairs. Enjoy a romantic dinner on the deck while enjoying the view.


The spacious primary king bedroom, equipped with an air conditioner, opens onto its own deck for sunrise views, stargazing, or sunbathing. Stairs from the deck lead down to the main deck or to the beach. A large double vanity bathroom with a shower, dressing table and laundry room adjoins the primary bedroom.

The guest bedroom has a private entrance and offers a king size bed with sliding glass doors that open onto a private deck that boast sunset and water views. This room is equipped with A/C. Right off the courtyard is the guest bathroom that has a large double vanity with a garden shower overlooking the beautiful Caribbean waters.

The lower bedroom is down one flight of stairs from the main floor and can be prepared with two twins or a king. This room offers A/C. The room opens up onto a covered alcove sitting area and offers a garden shower with a single vanity open air bathroom. Steps to the beach are off the covered alcove.

Eco-Friendly Beachfront Villa

Our simple but comfortable Villa caters to guests who are ECO-FRIENDLY, adventurous and minimalist because we utilize sustainable energy (backed up by batteries and the grid) and monitor responsible use of energy, water, cleaning agents and recycling.

Reef Bay Holiday Villa in Reef Bay on the South Shore of St. John, is a 4 bedroom, 4 bath Villa with a pool and hot tub. Spend your vacation surrounded by the Virgin Islands National Park. A 15-minute drive along a quiet road from the ferry in Cruz Bay brings the travel-weary vacationers to an idyllic island setting. Situated barely above the treetops and a 5-minute walk to the beach, lies the vacation home you will long to revisit.

This secluded, spacious Caribbean villa features Thai decor, tropical pastels, lush vegetation, and private pool. The villa is nestled in the woods with the jacuzzi in the front. Promoting outdoor living, socializing and simply Being.

You can choose to eat outside on this beautiful deck. Evenings gather on the balcony for sunset hues from billowing clouds, sails, and sunny faces!

You will find a wooded trail guarded by deer, birds, and crabs reaching a pristine beach within a 5-minute walk. Strolling further along the beach brings one to sugar mill ruins, mountain trails to petroglyphs and several additional quiet beaches.

The Great Room is in the center with comfortable furniture, lots of space, high ceilings, and views of the Caribbean through huge windows and doors. The kitchen includes all major and minor appliances, cooking utensils and a dishwasher. There are two primary suites with identical baths. Enjoy each morning with sunrise views over the hills and sea, listening to the breaking surf. Come stay at Reef Bay Villa and enjoy the private pool, hot tub, and beautiful views.

Check out our YouTube video!

properties.reviewsHtml:
Guest review

We’re of a group of four adult family members who have traveled to St John’s for the last nine years. We have tried numerous management companies staying at various villas throughout the island. This is the first villa we stayed in more than once and are planning our next year’s stay at this location. We have been spoiled with the best. The villa is everything it professes to be and so much more. The listing is accurate, the pictures are accurate, the private location and ease of parking, thoroughly cleaned inside and out, amenities, the convenience of electric power when the island lost power and villa layout. Highly recommend to family and friends. We’ll be back.

Guest review

This was a beautiful house located close to town yet secluded, access to the beach was wonderful for us. Enjoyed lounging around the pool with outside eating facilities and hot tub. House was more than comfortable for 8 people. Comfortable sleeping with the sound of waves heard even over the air conditioning which was just needed for the evening sleep. The screened porch was great for a getaway hideout, but we didn’t even have mosquito issues this trip. Thank you for opening your home to us. It was comfortable and lovely. Would definitely come back and recommend this home to friends.
