properties.descriptionHtml:
Perched into the hill 150ft above Rendezvous Bay, our property has one of the best views on St. John despite being only a quick, easy 4 minute drive from Starfish in town.

5 bedrooms with 6 King Beds, 2 Queen beds and a bunk bed (twin over full plus trundle), this makes it a total of beds for 18 to give our guests many sleeping options. Maximum occupancy is 10 adults plus 6 kids depending on age.

Flexible rates based on # of guests/bedrooms. Rent 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 bedrooms. Non-booked bedrooms will remain locked but empty, you will always be the only guests and have the 3500sqft pool and hot tub area to yourselves.

POOL AREA

Highlight of the property is a 5ft deep 15x30ft infinity pool, one of the largest private pools on St. John with one of the best pool views on St. John. There is a large hot tub build into the corner of the pool with a 3hp pump and 2 HP blower for bubbles.

The pool BBQ area with firepit, 2 fridges and ice maker is on the Western side of pool and under the living room of the main level. It is sheltered from the elements – you will be comfortably cool out of the sun and out of the wind. Even during strong thunderstorms where can rain sideways here you will stay dry (unlike some gazebos style sitting areas).

For cold nights or a late night swim, the gas firepit will keep you warm and cozy. There are large decks on both sides of the pool, the left hand side has a platform that can be used as daybed or for yoga, the right hand side is a expansive deck with 8 chaise lounges. It also features a covered wet bar/honor bar, blender and coffee maker. The pool is facing east, taking maximum advantage of view and trade winds. The sunrises are spectacular and you can catch a glimpse of the sunset from the Southern end of the deck.

Easy access, no steep narrow driveway, flat, easy parking. You will arrive at the property and park your car on the level of the pool which has an easy access and nicely hidden private entry from the parking. To get to the main entrance you have to walk up a few steps on a 40 degree incline over the lawn or a river rocks in concrete driveway. Not suitable for people with limited mobility. In return there are zero steps throughout the property and all bedrooms on main level are on the same level with interior connection. No walking on stairways to get from a bedroom to the main level.

LIVING AREA

While the pool is brand new – designed for a vacation rental and can compete with the ultra high end villas in terms of size, view while being more practical (shade, sun, wind, amenities), the main level feels more like a traditional West Indian large (multigenerational) family home with very large (some over 400sqft) bedrooms and a full size, fully equipped kitchen with Mahogany cabinets and granite counters that goes beyond most vacation rentals (bean to cup espresso machine, Keurig, normal coffee maker, Nespresso machine, hot dog toaster, sandwich maker, Ninja blender, soda maker and lots of pots, pans and utensils). There is a lot of practical stuff you will appreciate (beach gear, toys, games, electronics and provisions for power outages as well as superfast fiber optic internet with 12 access points and good coverage throughout property with satellite as backup should an underground cable be cut…..).

Our typical guests are multigenerational families or 2 families vacationing together. I would say we are less suited for 5 couples as there are not 5 equal primary suites. Each bedroom has a very unique layout and design. The pool area is always a big hit with the kids, young and old. The décor is modern and simple encouraging a worry-free stay, especially for families with energetic children.

The main level is overlooking the pool and has 3 patios: 37ft patio off the living room, a private 21ft patio for bedroom 4 as well as a 16 x 16ft deck off the back bathroom, so even when travelling in a large group you will find a quiet space to meditate or read a book. Families with young kids like the fact that the kids can’t escape to the pool via an open slider (a parent has to open the heavy front door), families with older kids enjoy privacy and peace on the large 37ft upstairs patio off the main living room while the kids have fun in the pool area. There is a second kitchenette with full size stove and fridge in the hallway to bedroom 3 and 4.

There is one bedroom and a large bathroom on the pool level, the bathroom has double shower and double vanity and can easily handle large groups coming back from beach wanting to swim, shower and use the hot tub.

There is always a good breeze blowing at hour property that keeps you cool and the mosquitos away. You can sit outside without being hot or eaten alive by mosquitos. 90-95% of the time the wind is nice to have, 5-10% of the time the wind is a little strong and you may hear it howling.

For the odd days with no wind we have state of the art inverter window A/C units in the bedroom for a good night’s sleep. The ACs in Bedroom 1 and 2 are technically speaking mini splits but in the shape of a U-shaped window unit where the outside and inside element are split by the window (Midea U shaped).

The majority of our guests does not need A/C especially during the winter and spring and our pricing is based on occasional/night time use only. The property is all about indoor/outdoor living with the sliders open and a gentle breeze flowing through the house. If you prefer central AC set to the 60s 24/7 we are not the right choice for you.

We can offer this property at a reasonable price as we the owners live on the same property with a separate entrance up the hill. We have our own pool and hot tub up there. Privacy is very important to us, we will not hear or see what is going on in the guest unit and you will normally not see us unless I am watering the plants in the front yard when you get back from beach. We can normally respond faster to issues and questions compared to villa management services that have many properties in their portfolio and a long drive to get to them. 3 indoor/outdoor cats live on property. They are not allowed inside the guest unit.

BEDROOM DETAILS:

All bedrooms have TV, Apple TV or Firestick/Roku, DVD player, Bluetooth speakers and state of the art inverter window AC. There is cable tv with premium channels in the living room and bedroom 4.

Bedroom1: 13 x 16ft. King Size Bed with 14” Molblly Premium Cooling Memory Foam Mattress, medium firm. Vintage Caneel Bay resort teak nightstands and hardwood sideboard.

Bedroom2: 16 x2 0ft. King size live and sleep resort sleep elite memory foam mattress on a platform bed. Twin over full bunk bed with trundle (small single size). Simpler child-proof furniture.

Bedroom 1 and 2 are separated by a bathroom so they do not share a wall.

Bathroom 1: walk in shower w/ natural stone floor, toilet, mahogany vanity.

Bedroom 3: 16x20ft – King Size bed w/ v resort sleep memory foam mattress, and a queen bed bed (live and sleep resort sleep memory foam).

Bedroom 4: 23 x 23ft – 2 x King Size beds w/live and sleep resort sleep memory foam mattress, Chair that can be turned into an additional single bed.

Bedrooms 3 and 4 are off a separate hallway. The hallway has a kitchenette with fridge, oven, microwave toaster and coffee maker.

Bedroom 5: King Bed with King Size Bed with 12” Molblly Premium Cooling Memory Foam Mattress, TV, loveseat, coffee table – on pool level.

Bathroom 2: Tub/Shower, Toilet, Mahagony vanity and exit to large wooden back patio with more amazing views.

Bathroom 3 (pool level): double shower, double vanity *120 solar panels and over 90kwh of backup batteries* We did not have power for 3.5 months after Irma and Maria so we are well equipped for power outages. For more photos check our instagram.

items: The pool pump is a solar powered completely off the sun. The infinity pump as well as the house water pump are solar powered as well.

San Costanzo features an open lay out with a gourmet kitchen and a large great room with cathedral ceilings. San Costanzo is a perfect island getaway for families, honeymooners, couples, or up to six friends.

San Costanzo also has 2.5, a fully equipped Gourmet kitchen, kitchenette downstairs and great room with cathedral ceiling, 32 in. flat screen H.D. TV, an extensive selection of reading materials, and a four person hot tub.

High atop Mamey Peak you will find SAPPHIRE PEAK, formerly known as Apito. The mid-island location and proximity to National Park Beaches makes this villa perfect to enjoy all of St. John. Amazing views of Bordeaux Mountain, Coral Bay, East End, Norman Island, Peter Island and beyond are visible inside and poolside from SAPPHIRE PEAK. 

Upon entering the great room, the large picture window takes advantage of showcasing the Caribbean view. Vaulted ceilings in the main floor level with rich wood tones add to the beauty of the space. The fully-equipped kitchen and the option of a 2 seat peninsula or a 4 seat balcony table are perfect for enjoying meals before or after your beach days. The triple water filtration system and automatic generator are a bonus to island living. The amenities include smart TVs and internet connection available in every room. One bedroom opens off the main floor living room offering a king bed, plenty of storage, ceiling fan, washer and dryer and a luxurious bathroom. A second spacious king suite is located poolside with an equally beautiful bathroom and large walk in shower. Though rarely needed on Mamey Peak, the villa is fully air-conditioned. 

After a day of fun and sun, a refreshing dip in the pool will leave you feeling re-energized for a delicious dining experience at one of St. John’s wonderful restaurants. Or you could have a local chef come cook for you while you relax and take in the views. The breezes atop Mamey Peak will keep you cool even on the hottest of nights. The sounds, scents, and sights of nature abound at SAPPHIRE PEAK. Tropical flowers, birds, tree-frogs, gentle trade winds, a million stars in the night sky, inspiring vistas of blue sea, sky, and green mountains are what make this location of St. John the perfect getaway. SAPPHIRE PEAK sits on almost an acre of lush pristine Caribbean paradise. SAPPHIRE PEAK’s mid-island location is ideal and unique… A quick 15 min. drive from Cruz Bay (all paved roads), a 10 min. drive to Coral Bay, and 5 min. drive to St. John’s legendary powder white North Shore Beaches. Reef Bay trail is only 5 minutes away. The lower bedroom is accessed by circular exterior steps. Not ideal for young children. 4WD is required for the bumpy road to the house. The house has AC and no screens in the windows.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Sea Palace Retreat is a private, over the top comfortable, fully loaded 2 bedroom, 2.5 bath rental villa, for you to enjoy the most amazing vacation the beautiful island of St. John has to offer.

Located in Coral Bay, which was placed #4 by New York Times Top 52 Places to Visit in 2016, is the quieter, more preferred side, most return travelers little secret, away from the busier Cruz Bay side. Due to the success of it’s neighboring, totally private In Harmony Retreat- a relaxing, couples one bedroom rental next lot over, the owner was encouraged to have a 2 bedroom, so his large number of return guests wish to travel with another couple or family member, they could have something to accommodate.

Sea Palace Retreat unique design has modern, rustic, Gothic, and even castle like characteristics with ruin touches of historic St. John. It is a solid concrete/ stone, non-creaky, well built vacation villa with all the amenities one could need on for a relaxing vacation.

The beautiful, Caribbean style, custom stone work throughout, granite and marble counter tops, and vanities, Italian porcelain tile, stoned outdoor shower in the primary bath to waterfall like glass in lower level bathroom, guests will enjoy comfort and unique features. A large, flat screen, smart TV with free Netflix and high speed internet are provided in the main living room as well as Cable TV with VCR and movies in bedrooms and lower lounge.

A modern, gourmet kitchen and a handy lower level kitchenette will make any one who likes or dislikes to cook on vacation, content.

There are two powerful air conditioners, one in each bedroom that can handle either entire floor if desired, but most guests get enough cool from the soothing, gentle trade winds, where this home is located on Seagrape Hill.

A beyond normal, huge spaced deck with bar, comfy outdoor furniture and stoned powder room, to enjoy the simply amazing, never ending views.

One can get plenty of sun as well on the lower, large, sun deck. Enjoy the fun, enticing, refreshing salt pool to sit or lounge (no dried out hair/ skin) or step into the warm, rejuvenating, spa pool under the vast starry sky at night.

There is a barbecue grill and picnic bench for fun backyard cookouts (one of the few rental that has a yard) with infinity views and even an outdoor shower in front, to wash off from beach. Pick fresh fruit & herbs from the surrounding Caribbean fruit trees or have an romantic dinner on the two top along the deck railings, just like the top restaurants.

Paved roads right up to villa. The home can be rented as a 1 level primary suite bedroom with lower pools and decks or bring along another couple, friend or family member to enjoy the 2nd bedroom level with separate entrance pathway along side of house or use the wide, spiral stairs. There is enough communal space for all to spend time or escape and have their private time. No children and only teenagers over 16. One or two couples are preferred but additional bedding can be provided for more than 4 with a charge. The owner is experienced in vacation management, having owned and managed several, he knows what renters need and and desire. Come discover this amazing rental, to serve as your deluxe tropical vacation retreat! If next door In Harmony Retreat happens to be available, you could rent both places to be close to your travel companions as well, but private. Sea Palace Retreat has it all- to retreat and get away from it all!

properties.reviewsHtml:
Guest review

Sea Palace Retreat is in an ideal location on Seagrape Hill (above Skinny Leg's) in Coral Bay. It is easy to get to on an all paved road, has great parking, and the views are amazing. Everything about the house is perfect. I can't think of one thing I would change!

Guest review

Greg has the house stocked with everything you would need from beach towels and coolers to ice packs for the coolers to games, binoculars, paper towels, toilet paper, garbage bags, cleaning supplies, etc. Also check out the bar to see what is there before you buy alcohol. The upstairs and downstairs are like their own separate places, but he doesn't rent them separately. The bed downstairs is a queen and upstairs is a king. The downstairs had it's own mini kitchen and smaller refrigerator (not a mini-fridge). More people could sleep there in the additional room. The bathrooms were perfect and upstairs has an outdoor shower. The pool and warming tub were perfect and the views from them were awesome!!!! We spent most of our time there either on the upstairs porch (which had awesome breezes and a 1/2 bath) or in the pool. We did spend one evening on the downstairs patio in the hammock and lounge chairs. The views are fabulous of both Coral Bay and East End! Oh to be back there right now! One other thing, this was our fourth time renting from Greg Kinslow and we absolutely love him! He is a top notch guy who takes excellent care of his properties. He lives below a nearby property, and he is basically invisible unless you need him and then he just appears :) We hope to rent from him for many years to come!

Overlooking sublime views of Peter Bay and beyond, Villa Seacove is set within lush landscaping replete with bananas, lime, papayas, citrus, coconut palms, and a soothing garden waterfall. A grand courtyard entrance welcomes you and hints at the magnificence within.

The main villa is an architectural masterpiece of polished coral stone floors, carved coral pillars, and dramatic archways set against an artistic counterpoint of native blue bit stone walls inlaid with seashells from around the world.

On the main level, the spacious great room’s high ceilings, custom hand-carved cypress furniture, and sectional sofas share space with dining areas and a wonderful gourmet kitchen outfitted with stainless-steel appliances including 2 refrigerators with icemakers, a gas cooktop, double ovens and a generous collection of tableware. French doors open out to additional outdoor dining and Seacove’s upper sun terrace which overlooks views of Peter Bay, the green National Park lands, the British Virgin Islands, and enchanting blue ocean views.

Adjoining the great room is the air-conditioned media room/library furnished with down-filled sofas and featuring beautifully handcrafted woodwork, a large-screen HD Satellite TV, music, movies, books, and a wet bar.

The air-conditioned king primary suite adjoins, with French doors that open to the upper sun deck. And a separate office with an internet-ready Laptop computer and a fax/copier/printer. A fabulous his-and-hers bathroom/dressing room completes this lavish suite.

Interior stairs lead to Seacove’s lower level and to its second living area equipped with a large-screen HDTV with satellite, a BluRay DVD system, iPod dock, wet bar, and mini-fridge; this area opens directly out to a covered terrace bordered by the heated pool, whimsically inlaid with tile turtles.

The second and third air-conditioned bedrooms, 1-king & 1-queen, and baths are situated on opposite sides of the pool terrace. Across the courtyard is the two-story Gatehouse, each level offering an air-conditioned queen bedroom/bath suite (the lower suite has a complete small kitchen, and the upper suite two scenic balconies). All bedrooms are air-conditioned and fully screened.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Sea Grape Estates is finally available and waiting for your arrival! As seen on House Hunters International multiple times. Enter into your own little resort in itself, with one of the largest pools and pristine properties in Coral Bay, never before available to the public.

Located in Coral Bay on Seagrape Hill across from Skinny Legs, Shops and the Dingy Dock making it an easy hop for a sail or power boat charter.

The Estate is situated on a hill, so you may enjoy the Caribbean breeze and unobstructed breathtaking views from sunrise to sunset from the large wrap around deck and gazebo, perfect for enjoying any meal, as well as the incredible star gazing and moon rises over the water at night. Perfect for a romantic week away from the city, or go big with larger groups or events.

We have upgraded the pool with improvements and converted to salt water, and the upper deck now has cable rails to improve the view.

Begin your relaxing get away in our beach style home, including 2 oversized primary bedrooms with private entries, upgraded full-size bathrooms, comfortable king size beds, and updated kitchen. Updates include luxurious large granite counter tops, sinks, stainless steel refrigerator, oven, gas stove, microwave, and toaster oven/broiler with extended peninsula. Dining at the round table inside seats 6, bar area seats 4.

The lounge area is equipped with a 48″ smart TV and boasts large windows with stunning ocean views. The main area is equipped with 48″ smart TV, while the primary suites and cottage have 40″ and 32″ smart TVs , respectively. All bedrooms have air conditioners.

Also available, rent our private poolside cottage with queen size bed, bathroom, outdoor shower, mini fridge, and breakfast nook, for more guests.

Besides the stunning views, enormous bedrooms with beautifully appointed bathrooms and kitchen, you will have a hard time deciding where to hang side for a swim, upper deck for happy hour or sunrise,  or an unforgettable moon rise. The property speaks for itself.

Coral Bay is the new hot spot on the island, known for its up and coming restaurants, easily accessible beaches (5 minute drive), and laid back friendly town.

Upon arrival, you will have access to a welcome book with loads of options for food and entertainment. Rental also includes snorkel gear and beach items, beach towels, comfortable deck furniture, BBQ, and hammocks.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Located in Great Cruz Bay, this Cliffside waterfront villa has a lovely pool, views without end, large fully air-conditioned great room, multiple dining options, abundant decks, 4 primary suites with A/C. Two King bedrooms upstairs on main level, one King bedroom and King, or Twin, bedroom downstairs, all surrounded by lovely native gardens. The house is extremely private. The whole house has WIFI high-speed internet available.

The Pool deck has plenty of lounging space and expansive views. The pool is 15′ X 6′ with a convenient sitting shelf for lounging with coffee or cocktails. The open-air great room of Serenity spills onto the multi-level deck area. The Living area sports comfortable furnishings. The outdoor, covered, upper dining area has Weber BBQ and sun shades, with easy access just off the kitchen.

The great room offers a full entertainment area with DVD/Cable TV and stereo as well as an indoor dining area that seats 6. You have the option of enjoying the natural trade winds or A/C. The kitchen is spacious and incredibly well equipped with an island between it and the great room encouraging relaxation and conversation. The two upper primary king suites of this three bedroom villa open out onto the deck and enjoy views of both the sea and gardens. Each suite has its own bath and air conditioning. There is also a private, outdoor shower.

Two bedrooms upstairs and one bedroom downstairs, all surrounded by lovely native gardens, makes this home a secluded retreat. Serenity Vista Villa sits high on the cliffside of Maria Bluff (the peninsula between Great Cruz Bay and Chocolate Hole). Convenient to Cruz Bay, yet located in one of St. John’s loveliest residential neighborhoods. Serenity is island living at its best.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Built and decorated in true Caribbean style, featuring expansive views of the open sea, cooling trade wind breezes, and a huge, sprawling deck perfect for entertaining your guests, or for a private evening of stargazing. Day and night, deck views sweeping well past 180 degrees provide eye-popping vistas of the Caribbean to the south, and to the broad expanse of the Fish Bay valley.

Here, you’ll bask in the warm glow of the morning sun as it rises above hills to the east, or while away hours watching sailboats at sea, and lose yourself in hours of dream-inducing evening stargazing.

The upstairs/downstairs layout, each level with its own spacious communal living area and large deck are perfect for families with children, or separate groups of couples wishing some ‘private space’ from time to time.

The main house upstairs (entrance level) features a living/dining area suitable for eight guests. The villa owner is a dedicated amateur chef, and the kitchen is equipped accordingly, providing everything you’ll need to prepare sumptuous meals on those evenings when you’re just not up to going out.  An outdoor gas grill easily accommodates any dinner party.

Away from the hustle and bustle of town, Southern Exposure offers guests the quiet and solace that brings people to St. John in the first place. And of course, the raised deck pool, surrounded by beautiful native stone and coral walls and an array of colorful bougainvillea, Alamanda, hibiscus and palm trees, will keep both adults and kids entertained for hours.

A second, beautifully appointed primary bedroom is located inside the main house on the same level and features a private bathroom and spacious tile shower. The main living area downstairs serves as a multi-purpose entertainment room, opening out to its own private covered tile deck with lounges, tables, and chairs. It has a wet bar, small refrigerator and two futons (that can be used as beds in a pinch).

For families, it’s an ideal ‘kids room’ complete with games, TV w/VCR, and CD player. Both downstairs bathrooms are directly accessible from the living area here. There is a laundry room in the lower level with a washer & dryer.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Sun Moon & Stars Villa, named for the amazing sun and moon rises that are viewed over the neighboring islands and the stars that shine overhead, will delight couples seeking a lover’s hideaway. This charming eco-friendly villa commands a fantastic view of St. John’s pristine East End and the many British Virgin islands and cays beyond, all dramatically staged against the vast blue backdrop of ocean and sky.

Sun, Moon & Stars Villa is a one-bedroom home just perfect for couples. Built all on one level for easy access, this villa offers a well-equipped kitchen and a spacious dining and living area with a cathedral ceiling, and an air-conditioned queen bedroom. Our home is powered by sustainable solar energy (with public utility backup) to virtually eliminate our impact on the environment and help preserve the natural beauty of St John.

French doors open from the living and dining areas to a wide covered verandah which overlooks that unparalleled sea view and catches the cool island trade winds. On one side is the secluded heated swimming pool, hot tub and sun deck in a lovely tropical garden setting. Relaxation and a good meal for two go together, so the wide covered verandah is furnished with a cushioned sofa and a table and chairs for alfresco dining; it’s shaded and cool by day and frames the sky at night for romantic stargazing.

Sun, Moon & Stars Villa is located high on a hill above Calabash Boom, reached by a winding country road, so the elevation and the balmy breezes usually keep the temperature at this property very comfortable, and provide the incredible views you’ll always remember. Behind you is National Park land.

Sun, Moon & Stars Villa is located on the quiet side of St. John, but Coral Bay’s bars, restaurants and small shops are just a couple minutes’ drive down the road. You can rent small boats and snorkel gear at Crabby’s, pick up some groceries at Lily’s Gourmet Grocery (or ask us to arrange to have your groceries purchased and delivered to your villa just before your arrival – what luxury!), enjoy a casual meal at Skinny Legs, and enjoy other Coral Bay restaurants. The Ram’s Head trailhead is just a few minutes’ drive from Sun, Moon & Stars Villa should you feel like hiking to some of the best views in the Caribbean.

Beautifully furnished in comfortable island style, this lovely and private villa is cozy, welcoming and provides the perfect vacation spot for couples young and old.

Four wheel drive vehicle required.

properties.reviewsHtml:
Guest review

Top of the world

Elaine P.

Sun, Moon & Stars is stunning. The view is unsurpassed. The house has everything you might need for the beach—beach bag, cooler, towels, umbrella. The kitchen is also fully stocked. We loved soaking in the hot tub first thing in the morning and last thing at night. Both the owner and the manager gave us very detailed and accurate directions. Coral Bay is the best end of the island…laid back and full of great people.

Guest review

Perfect Off The Grid Vacation

Guest review

We had a wonderful time. The home was On TOP of a mountain with commanding views. A 4×4 is necessary and a willingness to climb switchbacks. But once you are at the top it’s all fabulous. House was well appointed. Kitchen was used every night since we decided we would not be driving after sunset. Local Dolphin Market has everything you need- or take a ride to Cruz Bay and stock up at the Starfish market. Plenty of towels and chairs to take to the beach. Just bring your bathing suit and flip flops. Our favorite beach was Jumbie Beach next to Trunk but get there early -only 7 parking spots for that hidden gem. Property manager was easy to contact and showed us around the house upon arrival. Views are fantastic and it was fun to watch the sunrise every morning.

Sheryl H.

Tip to travelers- we had to add an international plan to our phones since the cell service in Coral Bay (for Verizon) comes from the BVIs. 

Guest review

Simply amazing

Guest review

Couldn’t have asked for a more perfect home, and vacation at that! This was our second trip to the island for a vacation (4th if you include two day excursions while cruising) and it was obvious to us Coral Bay is our preferred atmosphere. It was way more laid back and quiet than Cruz. This house enabled us to see more than we could imagine off the covered porch; the views are out of this world and having the sliding glass and screen doors made the breezes incredible! Although it had a beautiful pool and hot tub, the breezes cooled us off perfectly to where we didn’t need to use the pool, but the hot tub was used almost every day for an evening soak after long hikes. If you’re active, try doing as many trails as possible. That’s what sets St. John apart in our opinion! We also recommend visiting Hansen Bay and kayaking out to Lime Out—a green house boat) which serves drinks, amazing tacos, and merchandise (which you can see from this home’s view)!

Robert J.

It was great having the conveniences of towels, beach equipment, leftover bug spray, etc. So sad to have had to leave but we definitely have plans to come back with family in the coming years. However if ever it’s just the two of us, we will not have a doubt we will be back to SMS!

properties.descriptionHtml:
Welcome to your dream destination where views and amenities abound! This cottage, located in Coral Bay, is perfect for two and will accommodate up to four adults with guest 3 and 4 in the loft queen bed.

The air-conditioned main bedroom has a Queen bed, it’s own bathroom, it’s own deck and is separate from the living area upstairs. The upper deck provides a casual seating area coupled with “al fresco” dining for four while the lower sun deck is just outside the primary bedroom; both providing a scenic view of the sailboats coming to harbor in Coral Bay.

A full kitchen can accommodate everything from gourmet creations to simple, yet elegant. The second Bedroom requires going up a ships ladder to access the loft bedroom. This bedroom is two levels from the primary bedroom and only accessed outside if trying to get to the primary bedroom from the loft level!

You need to rent a Jeep or 4×4 like for you trip. Taxi’s are few are far between and very expensive. If your booking is less that 60 Days out you should reserve a Jeep before booking the Cottage as you may be left walking if you do not! The Island only has so many Jeeps!  Jeep and Ferry Info here.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Villa Bijou offers 3 King Suites, and 3 1/2 baths, with full A/C, lovely pool, and sundeck. Beautifully furnished, with native stonework throughout. A great house for relaxation, breathtaking views and comfort with easy access to town, dining and the north shore beaches.

Large (18′ x 10′ x 5′) heated pool and surrounding patio are private. The stone patio is furnished with a covered dining area while leaving a large sun-bathing space with loungers nearer the pool. The poolside wet bar offers granite counters, blender, fridge, and a ceiling fan.


The Living room and dining area are on the entry level with sweeping views. Each area is furnished with truly comfortable sofas and chairs. Open-air living and great breezes make for cool tropical living. There are ceiling fans throughout.

The Large gourmet kitchen has everything a serious cook could want with gorgeous granite counter tops, custom cabinetry and tons of counter space.

The adjacent “Palm Deck” has BBQ and seating for lounging and dining. Fabulous views into Great Cruz Bay and the Westin Beach (a short walk down the road), as well as to the outer cays, St Thomas and tropical sunsets abound.

The two entry level primary bedrooms each have king beds with full air-conditioning, private baths and garden views as well as cable TV/DVD/VCR’s.

At pool level the Third King suite also has full A/C, full bath with native stone shower and garden views. They can also be easily accessed from pool level without disturbing the bedroom area. The Pool Suite has TV/DVD/VCR and cable as well. A wet bar is all ready for pool side snacks and libations and there is dining adjacent top the banana garden.

properties.descriptionHtml:
As you leave the powder white sands and calm turquoise waters of Maho Bay, you travel a national park mountain road bordered by towering palm trees and other lush vegetation. At 1000 feet you ascend a steep private drive and behold a gorgeous Caribbean villa opening to spectacular views; you have arrived at Ixora. Ixora is the former home of the late Stephen Ambrose bestselling author and historian. The HBO series Band of Brothers was based on his book. Your sense of awe will be further enhanced as you step inside Ixora and survey this very beautiful and private, 5 bedroom, 4 bath, luxury home. Ixora consists of 3 traditionally styled buildings connected by decks, tiled walkways, and a garden patio. A 60-foot pool, surrounded by a 75 foot deck, a dining gazebo, abundant deck furniture, and stunning views provide a delightful daytime playground. At night the low voltage site lights, the breathtaking view, tranquil privacy, and the fabled Caribbean moonlight all combine to produce an irresistibly romantic, peaceful, and relaxing evening setting.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Experience the essence of “Kia Orana” – a wish for a long and fulfilling life – at Villa Kia Orana in Cruz Bay, St. John, USVI. This newly renovated luxury 4-bedroom, 6-bathroom villa offers an unparalleled escape with breathtaking views of the crystal-clear Caribbean waters. Situated on a quiet cul-de-sac just minutes from restaurants, shopping, and the pristine North Shore beaches, Villa Kia Orana provides the perfect balance of seclusion and convenience.

This villa features four primary suites, each with en-suite bathrooms, indoor and outdoor showers, and a hand-carved limestone bathtub. Enjoy the island breeze from over 120 feet of covered veranda that spans the entire length of the villa, offering panoramic views of the South Shore and Caribbean Sea from sunrise to sunset.

Ideal for multiple couples, families, intimate weddings, and corporate events, Villa Kia Orana is designed with luxury and comfort in mind. The expansive great room boasts a chef’s kitchen, dining area, and living space with surround sound, perfect for entertaining. Each bedroom is equipped with air conditioning to ensure comfort throughout your stay.

Whether you’re seeking relaxation, adventure, or an unforgettable event, Villa Kia Orana is the perfect retreat for your next island escape.

Features - 

Villa Kia Orana, Cruz Bay, St. John, US Virgin Islands

Spacious Indoor/Outdoor Living: With over 8,000 square feet of luxurious living space, Villa Kia Orana offers breathtaking views of Chocolate Hole, Heart Bay, and the Caribbean Sea from every window. Experience the perfect blend of comfort and stunning scenery.

4 Primary Suites & 6 Bathrooms: Enjoy the comfort and privacy of four equally appointed Primary Suites, each with its own en-suite bathroom. With a total of 6 bathrooms, every guest will experience ultimate luxury.

Game Room: Entertainment for the whole family is at your fingertips in this well-appointed space. Well supplied for playing at any age, this space is furnished with a pool table, video games, board games, and another lounging area with a TV.

The Largest Outdoor Kitchen in St. John: Villa Kia Orana features the largest fully-equipped outdoor kitchen in St. John. Designed for both home cooks and professional chefs, it’s perfect for preparing memorable meals while soaking in panoramic views.

Prime Location in Cruz Bay: Nestled on a quiet circular street, yet just 1 minute from the Westin Resort or the local market and less than 5 minutes to downtown Cruz Bay. Villa Kia Orana combines serenity with convenient access to dining, shopping, and St. John’s world-renowned beaches.

properties.reviewsHtml:
Tony M., May 2025

My family of four visited VKO in May 2025. This was the first home we have rented versus the usual resort and believe me when I tell you, it is well worth it. Owners Jill and Gabriel have recently remodeled this estate with every upgrade & detail including an outdoor chef’s kitchen and an outdoor shower space/massage area for the master suite! The views over Chocolate Hole is to die and by far was our favorite part of the trip having our morning coffee’s under the outdoor patio was simply stunning! They even have an outdoor propane fire pit for the evening time, but we did not use it. My kids were in heaven with their own deluxe bedroom suites and thought they were royalty! We visited the popular Windmill bar, which is not even 10 minutes away and has probably the best sunset I’ve ever seen in my life! Trunk Bay and the entrance to the Virgin Islands National Park is right there! Perfect location if you’d like to go to the different private beaches St. John has to offer! There is a convenient local supermarket three minutes away that was perfect for grabbing food for our dinners or snacks, etc. I highly recommend VKO for your family retreat or corporate function. You will not be disappointed.

Paul V. April 2025

We are a blended family of 10 and booked Villa Kia Orana for a birthday celebration for my wife. Per the host's suggestion, I scheduled Megan for a massage in the AMAZING outdoor bathroom that has a stone tub and windows that open to the cool breeze. It set the perfect tone to our week. The bedrooms are spacious and were very clean. Nice bedding too. The greatroom/kitchen was perfect for hanging out. The kids eat almost every meal sitting at the bar. I really enjoyed the outdoor kitchen. I BBQ'd a few times. The house is minutes from the best beaches and very close to town and the market. We already booked another week at Villa Kia Orana next year! Can't wait to go back!

properties.descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Villa Madeline ~ a cozy hillside villa with beautiful stone and mahogany wood work. Located in the quiet Eden neighborhood with gorgeous views overlooking Coral Bay. Less than a 2-minute drive or a short walk to the heart of Coral Bay’s restaurants and shops! The location is ideal for spending the day either out at Maho or the East End beaches, which are both a 10 minute drive away. Skinny Leg's, Dazey's Bayhouse, and the Coral Bay dinghy dock are all a short walk from the villa as well. You will find everything you need for a wonderful vacation.

The road leads up to a paved driveway with plenty of room for parking. Hard to find on St. John! Full kitchen is equipped with all you will need for those nights you wish to dine in. The water at Villa Madeline is filtered and treated with a UV light and is ready right out of the faucet for your enjoyment. No need for plastic water bottles here! Located off of the kitchen is a half bath and laundry room equipped with a full-sized washer and dryer for your use. The open-air living area extends from the kitchen where you will find your in-home entertainment. Dish TV and Wi-Fi included. The main living area is equipped with A/C and also features two large screened slider doors that look out over Coral Bay and allow the trade winds to circulate throughout. Exit through the glass sliders out onto the wrap around porch on the upper level where you can enjoy coffee in the morning while watching the sunrise over East End. The villa is also equipped with solar panels and a backup battery so in the event of an island power outage, you can still enjoy all of the amenities.

Exterior staircase takes you to the pool deck and lower-level bedrooms. Private pool overlooks Coral Bay. On the pool deck you will also find an outdoor shower with beautiful stonework as well as a bar area with gas grill for dining al fresco. Descend the steps a little further to reach the two lower bedrooms. Each bedroom is equipped with queen size beds, en-suite bathrooms and individual A/C units. Slider doors off of the bedrooms lead out onto the lower-level wrap around porch. The villa is perfect for one or two couples!

properties.descriptionHtml:
Villa South Palm is a luxury villa in the exclusive gated community of Virgin Grand Estates, an upscale neighborhood of multi-million dollar vacation homes on St. John’s spectacular Southwest Shore. Breathtaking natural beauty surrounds this four bedroom, four and a half bath home. The Villa rests on a hillside, so panoramic views and magnificent sunsets are plentiful.

The Villa is a model of classic Mediterranean style with beamed cathedral ceilings, coral stone floors, Doric columns, and French doors. Rich, warm colors and tastefully selected decor complement the grand views of Great Cruz Bay, the Caribbean Sea, St. Thomas, and smaller Caribbean islands. Rest easy knowing this house has Tesla Batteries with full power back up. The spacious veranda and sun terrace make the perfect spot to curl up with a good book in the sunshine or share cocktails while watching the sunset.

Villa South Palm is ideal for:

• Families, including multiple generations; all rooms are accessed by an interior staircase, much safer with small children; cribs available for rent on the island; first-floor laundry; satellite TV, fully-integrated audio system with indoor & outdoor speakers, board games, beach chairs, pool floats, and more to keep the young & young-at-heart entertained.

• Couples; four equal-sized primary bedrooms with king beds guarantee that each couple has a terrific room – all with sea views. Two have private balconies, and two share a private patio. Satellite televisions, ceiling fans & A/C, bedside reading lamps and built-in storage complete the picture. Our guests rave about the open air showers!

Villa South Palm is tranquil - set in a lush tropical oasis, yet central - easily travel on paved roads to the many restaurants and shops 10 minutes away in Cruz Bay or to one of St. John’s world-famous beaches.

Indoors, take advantage of the fully-equipped chef’s kitchen with cherry cabinets, granite counter tops and stainless-steel appliances, lounge in the great room, with its vaulted ceiling, 46” television, Wifi, or enjoy the views over Great Cruz Bay and St. Thomas from the many French doors. All bedrooms and common areas are individually air-conditioned. In addition, ceiling fans are located throughout Villa South Palm. Outdoors, the property is professionally landscaped with native stone walls.

Enjoy breathtaking views of the crystal blue water of Great Cruz Bay and the Caribbean Sea from poolside, or make the short drive into the town of Cruz Bay for dining, shopping, and vibrant nightlife. Whether you’re planning a romantic getaway or a memorable family adventure, Villa South Palm is a perfect choice.

Base nightly rates vary and additional per person per night charges and other fees may apply.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Stunning ocean views are the first sight for the Waterklip visitor. Entering from the quite street above, through the impressive electronic gate, guests meander down a graceful stone walkway, where the first smiles bloom with the sight of the welcoming pool and patio, overlooking the splendid turquoise sea. Located on the south-west end of St. John, within minutes of Cruz Bay boasts all the amenities necessary for a Caribbean holiday.

Compact, comfortable and complete, Waterklip is a perfect retreat for couples or small families. The spacious pool deck contains reclining chaise lounges for the sun worshipers who wish to soak up those warm sunny days. A round table with seating for four including a large umbrella is a perfect way to enjoy an afternoon lunch or candlelit dinner.

Meandering further along the balcony on the seaside of the house, guests are invited to have a seat and enjoy the fresh sea air, lingering sunsets and watch as the birds and boats entertain the beholder.


The comfortable living room with Saltillo tiles, Caribbean artwork, air conditioning, large rattan sofa with matching loveseat and glass topped coffee table beckons the guests to relax. The entrance into the primary bedroom is just beyond the living room. Gaze out to the ocean views or catch up with the news on the 32″ Flat Screen LCD TV. A large round table with seating for four is spacious enough to enjoy meals inside if you need a break from the sun. The living room, dining and kitchen areas are 27′ X 13′ with views from end to end.

A grill on the outside deck completes the kitchen amenities, equipped with all of the necessary elements for creating scrumptious meals while dining in comfort from the bar, interior or exterior tables. The breakfast bar with high stools along it outer side invites idle guests to provide company to the working chef.

WaterKlip Features:
.5 Mile to Cruz Bay, 5 minute drive
90′ Above Sea Level
750 Enclosed square feet of living space
360 Exterior square fee of decking
Nearest beach is Honeymoon
North-shore beaches are a 5-10 minute drive

The Primary Suite, contains a queen-sized bed with detailed white wicker headboard. This suite is 13″ X 13″ in size and includes nightstands on each with lamps for reading. A ceiling fan, air-conditioning, comfortable sitting chair and large 7 drawer dresser with mirror complete this living space. The full bath with shower is just to the right with large walk in closet for all your Caribbean attire.

The Cabana Guest Suite, opening off of the pool deck, offers a relaxing and cool respite. This suite is 13′ X 13′ in size, and includes two twin beds for singles or they can be converted into a king for a couple. While air-conditioning and a ceiling fan assure the occupant’s comfort, a full bath and shower, along with a night stand, lamp, boom box and comfy wicker chair supply the rest off what is needed for an enjoyable stay.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Welcome to the Windwardside Guest Cottage, a charming little cottage that enjoys gorgeous views of the east end of St. John, the neighboring British Virgin Islands and Coral Bay. This home can be rented in conjunction with the Main House at Windwardside or alone as your own little piece of paradise.

We have numerous storage areas in a compact home with a a view that rivals any on the island. At Windwardside Guest Cottage you will wake up in a four poster bed to a gorgeous view of the Caribbean sea framed by palm trees. You could easily create a post card from the view of this adorable cottage. The interior has a queen-size, four-poster bed, a small seating area, a kitchenette and a breakfast bar. The furnishings are both tasteful and cheerful.

Our goal in designing Windwardside Guest Cottage was to provide a romantic haven packed with amenities but at a reasonable price. We have many honeymoon guests that choose Windwardside Guest Cottage for precisely this reason.

It is a budget home that won’t make you feel like you have made any compromises. But the cottage is not only for honeymoon couples – it is a quaint and lovely cottage for any visitors to the island that want an intimate experience of our beautiful island with a gorgeous view. A small gas grill is also available if you prefer to prepare your meals overlooking the sea. The covered porch has a dining area and two lounging chairs where you can enjoy the trade winds or a good book while watching the sailboats pass by. A shower garden opens onto an uncovered deck. There you can have a relaxing evening soak in the hot tub under a starry Caribbean sky. The hot tub also has a wide view of the sea and total privacy.

Windwardside is managed by on island owners. We will meet you on arrival, arrange for discounted car rentals and provide the personal attention you need to make your stay with us as pleasant and relaxing as possible. We can also arrange for a driver to meet your flight for the 50 minute ride to the Red Hook ferry dock.

In short, Windwardside Guest Cottage offers a serene location, fabulous view, charming furnishings, a private hot tub, kitchenette and BBQ, plus dedicated staff that will organize your vacation from start to finish all for the price of a hotel room.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Windwardside, an elegant retreat with lovely furnishings, a beautiful view and lush tropical gardens. It is the most intimate and traditional of all of our homes In Coral Bay. The design is reminiscent of a bygone era in the Caribbean but the amenities are modern and designed for comfort. My husband (a retired builder on the island) and I designed this home. We have years of experience of offering visitors to the island an unusual experience that brings them outside of their day to day life but is a comfortable and welcoming home away from home. Recent renovations to the house have added much to its beauty and charm.

This traditional West Indian style home consists of multiple buildings with a large central courtyard. The main house consists of two buildings: the first is a detached bedroom/bathroom with a veranda that looks over the courtyard, gardens and sea; the second is the “great house”.

Our kitchen is small but extremely well appointed. Windwardside (in conjunction with the neighboring Guest Cottage) has always been my choice when we have had family visiting so it is well set up for any meals you wish to enjoy in the comfort of the villa. You will find all the equipment you need to prepare your meals at home including a high quality gas grill. For those who prefer to take a break from cooking on their vacations there are numerous restaurant within a few miles from the villa. Our staff will be happy to tell you about the offerings both in Coral Bay and Cruz Bay.

The charming detached bedroom has a four poster bed and opens onto a relaxing verandah. Fill the coffee pot the night before and surprise your partner with coffee on the verandah as a romantic way to start the day.

The primary bedroom has a full bath with a shower located in an enclosed shower garden that is open to the sky but totally private. If the weather doesn’t allow for that (a rarity on St. John) there is also an indoor shower and full bath located off the living room.

Windwardside shares the property with the neighboring Guest Cottage. They share no amenities except the parking area and are visually obscured from one another by thick tropical foliage.


Windwardside was created to meet the desire to travel in groups with friends and loved ones yet still maintain a sense of privacy while doing so. This focus on privacy also makes it a wonderful retreat for couples. The whole complex – the Great House (master bedroom, two baths) and the guesthouse (one bedroom, one bath) can be rented as one by larger groups. Smaller groups or couples can choose from either the main house or the guest house. When rented individually privacy is assured by the orientation of the buildings and the heavy plantings screening them from one another.

Windwardside makes every attempt to protect the beautiful environment that makes it such a special place. The majority of our power is from discretely placed solar panels. Gray water from our showers is recycled to water our beautiful tropical gardens. Whenever possible we use natural cleaning products including laundry soap. As more options open we will continue to add to our green environment efforts.

Our staff are long time members of the Calabash Cottages team and will do their best to help you plan your perfect vacation from start to finish. We hope to see you soon!

Location: Coral Bay, St. John, U.S. Virgin Islands. Windwardside is located in quiet seclusion with mesmerizing views of Coral Bay, nearby islands and the Caribbean Sea. The house is situated two thirds of a mile up a little used road in Coral Bay. Surrounded by tropical plantings and marvelous vistas, you are still just a short drive to a cool splash in Salt Pond Bay or other equally inviting white sand beaches. Restaurants, shops and watersports are all available within two miles in Coral Bay. The main town on the island, Cruz Bay, is located 8 miles away. The airport is in St. Thomas which is reached via a twenty minute ferry ride. (Ferries leave every hour on the hour – ferry rates).

Please note: We never advertise on Craigslist. We will never request guests to wire money directly to our bank accounts. If you should encounter either of these please contact us directly to avoid fraud.

properties.reviewsHtml:
Donna & David

We can't say enough good things about our stay at Windwardside Main House. You always wonder when you rent a place to stay if it will look as good as the pictures. Well, this place was even better than we could have imagined from the pictures. The customer service provided by Diane and Fitz throughout this process (from making the reservation, through the day we left) was superb. Fitz met us at the ferry, took us to pick up our rental car, took us to the grocery store and then to the house (and was very patient while we gathered our goods at the store). Diane checked on us after a couple of days to ensure we didn't have any questions or need anything. I've never had quite an experience like that when renting a property on vacation. The house had all the necessities for cooking, had beach items (towels, chairs, coolers and snorkeling gear), was quiet, and had spectacular views. The grounds were beautifully planted, and we could sit on the porch in the morning with our coffee, taking in the view and watching all the birds. We were concerned about renting a place that didn't have air conditioning in the bedroom, but we quickly got use to it, and the ceiling fan and breezes through the screened doors and windows made it very pleasant (an added plus to having no glass windows was being able to listen to the beautiful symphony of the night creatures..it was wonderful!). Some might think the drive up to the house is a bit daunting, but after a couple of times doing it, you become a pro. We were sad to leave such a beautiful place, but hope to be back very soon, and will definitely plan on staying here again.

Deb & Dave

We have stayed at Windwardside Cottage for a week every year for three years now. We just got back home and are already planning our next week there. Each year, the cottage has provided a comfortable and convenient home base from which to explore the wonderful island of St. John. We travel with another couple and there is plenty of privacy for everyone as well as delightful common space for meals and relaxing in the hot tub or on the porch. The views of Coral Bay are great! If you’ve never been, you can’t imagine how delightful it is to wake up and see such beautiful ocean, sky and flowers right from your bed!
